	:WaitForChild("GeneralStore_MaterialSplit")

local palette = {
	Walls = {Color3.fromRGB(238,218,179), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic},
	Timber = {Color3.fromRGB(117,78,52), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks},
	Roof = {Color3.fromRGB(144,82,61), Enum.Material.Slate},
	Stone = {Color3.fromRGB(145,139,126), Enum.Material.Cobblestone},
	Sage = {Color3.fromRGB(105,145,96), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic},
}

local roles = {
	"Walls",
	"Timber",
	"Roof",
	"Stone",
	"Sage",
}

local function roleOf(name)
	local n = string.lower(name):gsub("[^%w]", "")

	if n:sub(1,2) == "ak" then
		n = n:sub(3)
	end

	for _,role in ipairs(roles) do
		if n == string.lower(role) then
			return role
		end
	end
end

-- Brand-new runtime model.
local visual = Instance.new("Model")
visual.Name = "AK_RUNTIME_GeneralStoreVisual"

for _,obj in ipairs(source:GetDescendants()) do
	if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local p = obj:Clone()

		local role = roleOf(p.Name)
		assert(role, "Unknown General Store role: "..p.Name)

		local style = palette[role]

		p.Color = style[1]
		p.Material = style[2]

		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false

		p.Parent = visual
	end
end

assert(#visual:GetChildren() == 5, "Expected 5 MeshParts")

local targetCF,targetSize = target:GetBoundingBox()
local _,nativeSize = visual:GetBoundingBox()

local ratios = {
	targetSize.X/nativeSize.X,
	targetSize.Y/nativeSize.Y,
	targetSize.Z/nativeSize.Z,
}

table.sort(ratios)

visual:ScaleTo(
	visual:GetScale() * ratios[2]
)

local visualCF = visual:GetBoundingBox()

visual:PivotTo(
	targetCF
		* visualCF:Inverse()
		* visual:GetPivot()
)

-- Slight shell expansion over gray original.
visual:ScaleTo(
	visual:GetScale() * 1.002
)

local expandedCF = visual:GetBoundingBox()

visual:PivotTo(
	targetCF
		* expandedCF:Inverse()
		* visual:GetPivot()
)

-- Variables used in tracking if the character is using a ControllerManager.
-- This implementation assumes the common case of the ControllerManager being a
-- child of the character, and that only one ControllerManager exists under a given
-- character. If a ControllerManager is not placed under its associated character,
-- then it will not be detected by this script.
-- The basis for this decision is performance: A ChildAdded listener on the
-- character is less of a performance hit than a ChildAdded listener on the
-- Workspace. And a FindFirstChild is more performant than checking for multiple
-- controllers via GetChildren.
local groundSensorChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerRootChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerParentChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local charGroundSensor:ControllerPartSensor? = nil
local charControllerManager:ControllerManager? = nil

local CCLAnimationFixed
do
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings():IsUserFeatureEnabled("UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed")
	end)
	CCLAnimationFixed = success and result
end

-- Clean up listeners associated with the character's ControllerManager
function resetManagerListeners()
	if groundSensorChangedListener then
		groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
		groundSensorChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerRootChangedListener then
		managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerRootChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerParentChangedListener then
		managerParentChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerParentChangedListener = nil
	end
end

-- Clean up all listeners and reset state.
function teardownManager()
	resetManagerListeners()
	charGroundSensor = nil
	charControllerManager = nil
end

-- Returns true if checkManager controls the character associated with this script
-- If so, then checkManager is assigned to charControllerManager.
-- TODO: Remove this method when UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed is made permanently true.
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager:ControllerManager):boolean
	if checkManager.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
		if charControllerManager ~= checkManager then
			resetManagerListeners()
			charGroundSensor = checkManager.GroundSensor
			groundSensorChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
					groundSensorChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerRootChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
					managerRootChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerParentChangedListener = checkManager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					resetManagerListeners()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			charControllerManager = checkManager
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Attach to a confirmed-valid manager: record it, read its current GroundSensor,
-- and watch for GroundSensor changes, RootPart changes, and removal.
function setupManager(manager:ControllerManager)
	charControllerManager = manager
	charGroundSensor = manager.GroundSensor

	groundSensorChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		charGroundSensor = charControllerManager.GroundSensor
	end)

	managerRootChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		if manager.RootPart ~= Character.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)

	managerParentChangedListener = manager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end

-- Looks for the first ControllerManager directly childed to the character. If such
-- a controller does not exist or if it does not control that character, then a listener
-- is set up to check if a controller is ever added.
function lookForControllerManager()
	if CCLAnimationFixed then
		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(child)
			else
				-- Manager exists but RootPart not yet assigned; wait for it.
				local rootPartListener:RBXScriptSignal
				rootPartListener = child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
						rootPartListener:Disconnect()
						setupManager(child)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(newChild)
				if newChild:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		charGroundSensor = nil
		charControllerManager = nil

		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child)
		end
		-- The call to processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter above will have
		-- assigned charControllerManager on success
		if charControllerManager == nil then
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child) then
						managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
						managerAddedListener = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(set, anim)
	if set == nil or anim == nil then
		return 0
	end

	for idx = 1, set.count, 1 do
		if set[idx].anim.AnimationId == anim.AnimationId then
			return idx
		end
	end

	return 0
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))

		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end

	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

			Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
		end

-- ANIMATION

-- declarations
local toolAnim = "None"
local toolAnimTime = 0

local jumpAnimTime = 0
local jumpAnimDuration = 0.31

local toolTransitionTime = 0.1
local fallTransitionTime = 0.2

local currentlyPlayingEmote = false

-- functions

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	if currentlyPlayingEmote then
		oldAnim = "idle"
		currentlyPlayingEmote = false
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end

	-- clean up walk if there is one
	if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			-- When auto scaling is not enabled, the rig scale stands in for
			-- a computed scale.
			return getRigScale()
		end

		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end
	return getRigScale()
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local timeWarp = 1

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
	else
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
		setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
			if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end

			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end

				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end

			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight)
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then

		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			runAnimTrack = nil
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)

		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)

			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then

		if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			toolAnimTrack:Stop()
			toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
			transitionTime = 0
		end

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		if priority then
			toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
		end

		-- play the animation
		toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		toolAnimName = animName
		toolAnimInstance = anim

		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
	end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

-- STATE CHANGE HANDLERS

function onRunning(speed)
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()

	-- Adjust the walking speed if a ControllerManager is being used.
	-- "speed" is world speed, whereas we want local speed.
	-- IE, do not animate a walk if the character is stationary atop
	-- a moving platform.
	if charGroundSensor ~= nil and Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local hrp = Humanoid.RootPart
		local sensedPart = charGroundSensor.SensedPart
		if sensedPart then
			local pos = charGroundSensor.HitFrame.Position
			local floorVel = sensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(pos)
			local assemblyVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			-- Ignore y-velocity, so that jumping does not influence the animation speed
			local relVel = Vector3.new(assemblyVel.X - floorVel.X, 0, assemblyVel.Z - floorVel.Z)
			local relSpeed = relVel.Magnitude
			local moveMag = charControllerManager.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if moveMag < 0.1 then
				relSpeed = 0
				moveMag = 0
			elseif moveMag > 1.0 then
				moveMag = 1.0
			end
			speed = relSpeed * moveMag
		end
	end

	local movedDuringEmote = currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and (Humanoid.WalkSpeed / heightScale) or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold * heightScale then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

	playAnimation("jump", 0.1, Humanoid)
	jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimDuration

function animateTool()
	if (toolAnim == "None") then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", toolTransitionTime, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		return
	end

	if (toolAnim == "Slash") then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	end

	if (toolAnim == "Lunge") then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	end
end

function getToolAnim(tool)
	for _, c in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == "toolanim" and c.className == "StringValue" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

-- Rate limiting
local LOG_RATE_LIMIT = 10 -- max logs per second
local logCount = 0
local lastResetTime = tick()

local function canSendLog()
	local now = tick()
	if now - lastResetTime >= 1 then
		logCount = 0
		lastResetTime = now
	end

	if logCount >= LOG_RATE_LIMIT then
		return false
	end

	logCount = logCount + 1
	return true
end

-- Send log to server
local function sendLog(level, message, traceback)
	if not canSendLog() then return end

	clientLogEvent:FireServer({
		level = level,
		message = message,
		traceback = traceback
	})
end

-- Map MessageType to log level
local function getLogLevel(messageType)
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then
		return "error"
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		return "warning"
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageInfo then
		return "info"
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageOutput then
		return "debug" -- print() statements
	end
	return "info"
end

-- Listen for client-side log messages

-- AI NOTE: Client-side code executor for run_lua_code client context.
-- Mirrors server-side CodeExecutor: loadstring + pcall with print capture via LogService.
-- Runs in client context so LocalPlayer, PlayerGui, and client-only APIs are accessible.

local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PREFIX = "[SuperbulletCodeExecutor]"

-- Client always uses custom Loadstring module (built-in loadstring not available for clients)
local loadstringFn
local success, customLoadstring = pcall(function()
	return require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Loadstring)
end)
if success then
	loadstringFn = customLoadstring
else
	warn(PREFIX, "Client: Loadstring module not found at ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Loadstring")
	warn(PREFIX, "Client code execution will not be available")
end

local ClientCodeExecutor = {}

function ClientCodeExecutor.execute(code)
	if not loadstringFn then
		return {
			success = false,
			error = "Loadstring module not available. Add Loadstring to ReplicatedStorage.Packages.",
		}
	end

	local capturedOutput = {}

	local logConnection = LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
		if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageOutput then
			table.insert(capturedOutput, message)
		end
	end)

	local startTime = os.clock()

	local fn, compileError = loadstringFn(code)
	if not fn then
		logConnection:Disconnect()
		return {
			success = false,
			error = "Compile error: " .. tostring(compileError),
		}
	end

	local execSuccess, execResult = pcall(fn)
	local executionTime = math.floor((os.clock() - startTime) * 1000)

	logConnection:Disconnect()

	if not execSuccess then
		return {
			success = false,
			error = tostring(execResult),
		}
	end

	local output = table.concat(capturedOutput, "\n")
	if execResult ~= nil then
		if output ~= "" then
			output = output .. "\n" .. tostring(execResult)
		else
			output = tostring(execResult)
		end
	end

	return {
		success = true,
		output = output,
		executionTime = executionTime,
	}
end

return ClientCodeExecutor

local lightingProperties = { "Brightness", "ClockTime", "ExposureCompensation", "FogStart", "FogEnd", "FogColor", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ColorShift_Top", "ColorShift_Bottom" }

-- The folder is a client-local index of managed effects. Roblox renders
-- Atmosphere/post effects under Lighting and Clouds under Terrain, so the live
-- instances cannot be placed inside this folder without disabling them.
local visualFolder = Lighting:FindFirstChild("AK_WeatherVisuals")
if not visualFolder then
	visualFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	visualFolder.Name = "AK_WeatherVisuals"
	visualFolder.Parent = Lighting
end
local function indexEffect(className, effect)
	local reference = visualFolder:FindFirstChild(className)
	if not reference or not reference:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		reference = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		reference.Name = className
		reference.Parent = visualFolder
	end
	reference.Value = effect
end
local effects = {}
local initialEffects = {}
local createdEffects = {}
local terrain = workspace.Terrain
local requiredEffects = { "Atmosphere", "ColorCorrectionEffect", "BloomEffect", "BlurEffect", "SunRaysEffect", "Clouds" }
local effectLabels = {
	ColorCorrectionEffect = "ColorCorrection", BloomEffect = "Bloom",
	BlurEffect = "Blur", SunRaysEffect = "SunRays",
}

local function ensureEffect(className, parent)
	local effect = effects[className]
	if effect and effect.Parent == parent then
		if DEBUG_VISUALS then print("[WeatherVisuals] " .. (effectLabels[className] or className) .. " ready") end
		return effect
	end
	effect = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(className)
	if effect and not initialEffects[className] then
		local snapshot = {}
		for _, property in ipairs(effectProperties[className]) do snapshot[property] = effect[property] end
		initialEffects[className] = snapshot
		createdEffects[className] = nil
	end
	if not effect then
		local ok, result = pcall(Instance.new, className)
		if not ok then
			warn("[WeatherVisuals] Cannot create " .. className .. ": " .. tostring(result))
			return nil
		end
		effect = result
		effect.Name = "AK_Weather" .. className
		if effect:IsA("PostEffect") then effect.Enabled = false end
		if className == "Atmosphere" then
			effect.Density = 0
			effect.Haze = 0
			effect.Glare = 0
		elseif className == "Clouds" then
			effect.Cover = 0
			effect.Enabled = false
		end
		effect.Parent = parent
		createdEffects[className] = true
	end
	effects[className] = effect
	indexEffect(className, effect)
	if DEBUG_VISUALS then print("[WeatherVisuals] " .. (effectLabels[className] or className) .. " ready") end
	return effect
end

-- Capture the real map appearance before any weather instance is created.
for className, properties in pairs(effectProperties) do
	local parent = className == "Clouds" and terrain or Lighting
	local effect = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(className)
	if effect then
		local snapshot = {}
		for _, property in ipairs(properties) do snapshot[property] = effect[property] end
		initialEffects[className] = snapshot
		effects[className] = effect
		indexEffect(className, effect)
	end
end

local function trackTween(instance, properties, seconds)
	if not instance then
		warn("[WeatherVisuals] Cannot tween a missing visual instance")
		return nil
	end
	local ok, animation = pcall(TweenService.Create, TweenService, instance, TweenInfo.new(seconds or TRANSITION, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), properties)
	if not ok then
		warn("[WeatherVisuals] Tween failed for " .. instance.Name .. ": " .. tostring(animation))
		-- Keep the preset visible even if a property cannot be tweened in Studio.
		for property, value in pairs(properties) do
			local setOk, setError = pcall(function() instance[property] = value end)
			if not setOk then warn("[WeatherVisuals] Cannot set " .. instance.Name .. "." .. property .. ": " .. tostring(setError)) end
		end
		return nil
	end
	table.insert(runningTweens, animation)
	animation.Completed:Connect(function()
		local index = table.find(runningTweens, animation)
		if index then table.remove(runningTweens, index) end
	end)
	animation:Play()
	return animation
end

local function cancelTweens()
	-- Cancel may fire Completed synchronously; swap the list first so its
	-- removal callback cannot skip every other active tween.
	local oldTweens = runningTweens
	runningTweens = {}
	for _, animation in ipairs(oldTweens) do animation:Cancel() end
end

local function playWeatherSound(kind, volume, looped)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "AK_Weather" .. kind
	sound.SoundId = soundAssets[kind]
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.Volume = 0
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	table.insert(activeSounds, sound)
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		local index = table.find(activeSounds, sound)
		if index then table.remove(activeSounds, index) end
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	sound:Play()
	trackTween(sound, { Volume = volume }, looped and 1.4 or 0.12)
	if DEBUG_VISUALS then print("[WeatherVisuals] Audio: " .. kind) end
	task.delay(5, function()
		if DEBUG_VISUALS and sound.Parent and not sound.IsLoaded then
			warn("[WeatherVisuals] Audio not loaded: " .. kind .. " (check Creator Store access)")
		end
	end)
	if not looped then
		task.delay(6, function()
			local index = table.find(activeSounds, sound)
			if index then table.remove(activeSounds, index) end
			if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end
		end)
	end
	return sound
end

local function fadeWeatherSounds()
	local oldSounds = activeSounds
	activeSounds = {}
	for _, sound in ipairs(oldSounds) do
		if sound.Parent then
			trackTween(sound, { Volume = 0 }, 0.35)
		task.delay(0.4, function() sound:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
end

local function restoreOriginal(token)
	trackTween(Lighting, original)
	for className, effect in pairs(effects) do
		local snapshot = initialEffects[className]
		if snapshot then
			local numericAndColor = {}
			for property, value in pairs(snapshot) do
				if property ~= "Enabled" then numericAndColor[property] = value end
			end
			trackTween(effect, numericAndColor)
			if snapshot.Enabled ~= nil then
				task.delay(TRANSITION, function()
					if token == generation then effect.Enabled = snapshot.Enabled end
				end)
			end
		else
			-- Newly created effects fade to neutral, then leave Lighting entirely.
			if className == "Atmosphere" then trackTween(effect, { Density = 0, Haze = 0, Glare = 0 }) end
			if className == "Clouds" then trackTween(effect, { Cover = 0 }) end
			if className == "ColorCorrectionEffect" then trackTween(effect, { Brightness = 0, Contrast = 0, Saturation = 0, TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }) end
			if className == "BloomEffect" then trackTween(effect, { Intensity = 0 }) end
			if className == "SunRaysEffect" then trackTween(effect, { Intensity = 0 }) end
			if className == "BlurEffect" then trackTween(effect, { Size = 0 }) end
		end
	end
	task.delay(TRANSITION + 0.05, function()
		if token ~= generation then return end
		for className in pairs(createdEffects) do
			local effect = effects[className]
			if effect then effect:Destroy() end
			effects[className] = nil
			indexEffect(className, nil)
		end
	end)
end

local function ensureEffects()
	local ready = true
	for _, className in ipairs(requiredEffects) do
		local parent = className == "Clouds" and terrain or Lighting
		if not ensureEffect(className, parent) then ready = false end
	end
	return ready
end

local function clearEvent(restore)
	generation += 1
	cancelTweens()
	fadeWeatherSounds()
	if followConnection then followConnection:Disconnect(); followConnection = nil end
	if runtime then runtime:Destroy(); runtime = nil end
	if DEBUG_VISUALS and activeEventId then print("[WeatherVisuals] Clearing previous effects") end
	if DEBUG_VISUALS and activeEventId then print("[WeatherVisuals] Clearing " .. activeEventId) end
	if DEBUG_VISUALS and restore and activeEventId then print("[WeatherVisuals] Restoring defaults") end
	activeKey = nil
	activeEventId = nil
	if restore then restoreOriginal(generation) end
end

local function startLoop(kind, token, rig, preset)
	if not kind then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		local step = 0
		while token == generation and runtime do
			if kind == "Lightning" then
				lightning(token, rig, preset)
			elseif kind == "Meteors" then
				meteor(token, rig)
				meteor(token, rig)
				if rng:NextNumber() > 0.55 then meteor(token, rig) end
				playWeatherSound("Meteor", 0.26, false)
			elseif kind == "Spirits" then
				spirit(token, rig)
			elseif kind == "Wind" then
				local gusts = rig:FindFirstChild("WindStreaksParticles")
				if gusts then gusts:Emit(55) end
				trackTween(effects.Clouds, { Cover = rng:NextNumber(0.58, 0.9) }, 2)
			elseif kind == "Chaos" then
				step += 1
				trackTween(effects.ColorCorrectionEffect, { TintColor = Color3.fromHSV((step * 0.17) % 1, 0.46, 1), Saturation = 0.28 + (step % 2) * 0.15 }, 2)
				trackTween(effects.Atmosphere, { Color = Color3.fromHSV((step * 0.13) % 1, 0.4, 1) }, 2)
				if step % 3 == 0 then lightning(token, rig, preset) end
			elseif kind == "Nightmare" then
				trackTween(effects.BloomEffect, { Intensity = step % 2 == 0 and 0.34 or preset.bloom }, 1.5)
				step += 1
			elseif kind == "Admin" then
				step += 1
				trackTween(effects.ColorCorrectionEffect, { TintColor = Color3.fromHSV((step * 0.12) % 1, 0.34, 1) }, 2)
				if step % 3 == 0 then lightning(token, rig, preset) end
				if step % 2 == 0 then meteor(token, rig) end
			end
			local pause = kind == "Lightning" and rng:NextNumber(4, 8)
				or kind == "Meteors" and rng:NextNumber(1.4, 2.3)
				or kind == "Spirits" and rng:NextNumber(1.2, 2.1)
				or kind == "Wind" and rng:NextNumber(2, 3.4)
				or 3
			-- Short waits let a replaced event stop promptly without another connection.
			local elapsed = 0
			while elapsed < pause and token == generation do
				elapsed += task.wait(math.min(0.25, pause - elapsed))
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function applyEvent(eventId, key)
	local preset = presets[eventId]
	if not preset or not definitions[eventId] then return end
	clearEvent(false)
	if not ensureEffects() then
		warn("[WeatherVisuals] Preset " .. eventId .. " skipped: required visual effect missing")
		return
	end
	activeKey = key
	activeEventId = eventId
	local token = generation
	if DEBUG_VISUALS then print("[WeatherVisuals] Applying preset: " .. eventId) end
	runtime = Instance.new("Folder")
	runtime.Name = "WeatherVFX"
	runtime.Parent = workspace
	local rig = makePart("WeatherEmitterRig", runtime, Vector3.new(52, 2, 52), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1)
	rig.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 16, -8) or CFrame.new()
	local skyParts = {}
	followConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera and rig.Parent then
			rig.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 16, -8)
			for _, child in ipairs(skyParts) do
				local localCFrame = child:GetAttribute("LocalCFrame")
				local drift = CFrame.new()
				if child.Name == "AuroraRibbon" then
					drift = CFrame.new(math.sin(os.clock() * 0.35 + child.Color.R * 4) * 2, math.sin(os.clock() * 0.5) * 1.2, 0)
				elseif child.Name == "VoidWisp" then
					drift = CFrame.new(math.sin(os.clock() * 0.6 + child.Color.B) * 2, math.cos(os.clock() * 0.55) * 1.5, 0)
				end
				child.CFrame = rig.CFrame * localCFrame * drift
			end
		end
	end)
	local tint = preset.tint
	trackTween(Lighting, {
		ClockTime = preset.clock, Brightness = preset.brightness,
		ExposureCompensation = preset.exposure, FogStart = preset.fogStart or math.min(25, preset.fog * 0.1), FogEnd = preset.fog,
		FogColor = tint, Ambient = tint:Lerp(color(85, 92, 111), 0.65),
		OutdoorAmbient = tint:Lerp(color(136, 142, 157), 0.5),
		ColorShift_Top = tint:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.72),
		ColorShift_Bottom = tint:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.84),
	})
	trackTween(effects.Atmosphere, { Density = preset.atmosphere, Color = tint, Decay = tint:Lerp(color(69, 73, 102), 0.6), Haze = preset.atmosphere * 4, Glare = 0.12 })
	trackTween(effects.Clouds, { Cover = preset.clouds, Density = math.clamp(preset.clouds * 0.8, 0, 1), Color = tint })
	effects.Clouds.Enabled = true
	local correction = effects.ColorCorrectionEffect
	correction.Enabled = true
	trackTween(correction, { Brightness = 0, TintColor = tint, Saturation = preset.saturation, Contrast = (eventId == "Nightmare" or eventId == "BloodMoon" or eventId == "Inverted") and 0.23 or 0.08 })
	local bloom = effects.BloomEffect
	bloom.Enabled = true
	trackTween(bloom, { Intensity = preset.bloom, Size = 24, Threshold = 1.15 })
	local rays = effects.SunRaysEffect
	rays.Enabled = preset.rays > 0
	if rays.Enabled then trackTween(rays, { Intensity = preset.rays, Spread = 0.75 }) end
	local blur = effects.BlurEffect
	blur.Enabled = (preset.blur or 0) > 0
	if blur.Enabled then trackTween(blur, { Size = preset.blur }) end
	if DEBUG_VISUALS then
		print("[WeatherVisuals] FogStart: " .. tostring(preset.fogStart or math.min(25, preset.fog * 0.1)) .. " FogEnd: " .. tostring(preset.fog))
		print("[WeatherVisuals] ClockTime: " .. tostring(preset.clock))
		print("[WeatherVisuals] Atmosphere Density: " .. tostring(preset.atmosphere))
		task.delay(TRANSITION + 0.05, function()
			if token ~= generation then return end
			print("[WeatherVisuals] Applied values: FogStart=" .. tostring(Lighting.FogStart)
				.. " FogEnd=" .. tostring(Lighting.FogEnd)
				.. " ClockTime=" .. tostring(Lighting.ClockTime)
				.. " Atmosphere Density=" .. tostring(effects.Atmosphere.Density))
		end)
	end
	if preset.particles then addParticles(preset.particles, rig) end
	if preset.extraParticles then addParticles(preset.extraParticles, rig) end
	local ambient = ambientSounds[eventId]
	if ambient then playWeatherSound(ambient[1], ambient[2], true) end
	if preset.sky then
		addSky(preset.sky, rig)
		for _, child in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and child:GetAttribute("LocalCFrame") then
				table.insert(skyParts, child)
			end
		end
	end
	startLoop(preset.loop, token, rig, preset)
end

local function refreshFromState()
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	if phase == "Break" then
		if activeKey then clearEvent(true) end
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "Event" then
		if activeKey then clearEvent(true) end
		return
	end
	local id = state:GetAttribute("EventId")
	if type(id) == "string" then id = aliases[id] or id end
	local startedAt = state:GetAttribute("StartedAt")
	local endsAt = state:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
	if type(id) ~= "string" or not definitions[id] or not presets[id]
		or type(startedAt) ~= "number" or type(endsAt) ~= "number"
		or startedAt <= 0 or endsAt <= startedAt or endsAt <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
		if type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" and not definitions[id] and DEBUG_VISUALS then
			warn("[WeatherVisuals] Unknown event: " .. id)
		end
		if activeKey then clearEvent(true) end
		return
	end
	local key = id .. ":" .. tostring(startedAt)
	if key ~= activeKey then applyEvent(id, key) end
end

state.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attribute)
	if attribute ~= "Phase" and attribute ~= "EventId" and attribute ~= "StartedAt" and attribute ~= "EndsAt" then return end
	if refreshQueued then return end
	refreshQueued = true
	task.defer(function()
		refreshQueued = false
		refreshFromState()
	end)
end)
if not ensureEffects() then warn("[WeatherVisuals] One or more required effects were unavailable at startup") end
refreshFromState()
if DEBUG_VISUALS then print("[WeatherVisuals] Initialized") end

local function cycle(step)
	if not activeIndex then return end
	for offset = 1, #ids do
		local index = (activeIndex - 1 + step * offset) % #ids + 1
		if points:FindFirstChild(ids[index]) then
			remote:FireServer("Select", ids[index])
			return
		end
	end
end

local Spectate = {}
Spectate.__index = Spectate

function Spectate.new(onStopped)
	local self = setmetatable({connections={}, generation=0, onStopped=onStopped}, Spectate)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() self:Stop(true, true) end)
	return self
end

function Spectate:Stop(restore, notify)
	if not self.active then return end
	self.active = false
	self.generation += 1
	for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	self.connections = {}
	if restore then
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		-- A Phase 1 map camera may already have taken control while the
		-- server's spectate-stop response was in flight. Preserve that handoff.
		if camera and camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			local character = player.Character
			camera.CameraSubject = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
		end
	end
	self.onStopped(notify)
end

function Spectate:Start(userId, position)
	self:Stop(true, false)
	self.active = true
	self.generation += 1
	local generation = self.generation
	local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if not target then self:Stop(true,true); return end
	task.spawn(function()
		if workspace.StreamingEnabled and typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
			pcall(player.RequestStreamAroundAsync, player, position, 5)
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 8
		local humanoid
		repeat
			if generation ~= self.generation then return end
			local character = target.Character
			humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		until os.clock() >= deadline or target.Parent ~= Players
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then self:Stop(true,true); return end
		-- Give the Phase 1 Close response time to restore its own camera first.
		task.defer(function()
			if generation ~= self.generation then return end
			local function follow()
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if camera then camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom; camera.CameraSubject=humanoid end
			end
			follow()
			table.insert(self.connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(follow))
			table.insert(self.connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function() self:Stop(true,true) end))
			table.insert(self.connections, target.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() self:Stop(true,true) end))
			table.insert(self.connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leaving) if leaving == target then self:Stop(true,true) end end))
		end)
	end)
end

return Spectate

		for id, button in pairs(rowButtons) do button.BackgroundColor3 = id == self.selected and C.Blue or C.Card end

	announcement.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;announcement.TextScaled=false;announcement.TextSize=22;announcement.TextWrapped=true;announcement.ClearTextOnFocus=false
	announcement.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;announcement.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

		eventButtons[id]=UI.Button(eventList,Events[id].DisplayName,0,(index-1)*40,eventListWidth-14,34,function()
			self.eventId=id
			for key,button in pairs(eventButtons) do button.BackgroundColor3=key==id and C.Blue or C.Card end
		end,C.Card)
	end
	eventList.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#eventIds*40)
	UI.Label(frames.EventQueue,"QUEUED EVENT",detailX,52,detailWidth,23,18,C.Muted)
	local queuedLabel=UI.Label(frames.EventQueue,"None",detailX,75,detailWidth,30,24)

	UI.Button(frames.EventQueue,"QUEUE EVENT",detailX,109,queueButtonWidth,36,function()

	UI.Button(frames.EventQueue,"EMERGENCY WEATHER RESET",detailX,175,detailWidth,32,function() send({Action="EmergencyReset"}) end,C.Card)

	local logText=UI.Label(logs,"No admin activity yet",0,0,842,220,20,C.White)
	logText.TextWrapped=true
	logText.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	function self:Update(state)
		self.state=state
		for _,gui in ipairs(self.surfaces) do gui.Enabled=state.Authorized and state.InRoom end
		local keys={}
		local selectedExists=false
		for _,entry in ipairs(state.Players or {}) do
			table.insert(keys,entry.UserId..":"..entry.Username..":"..entry.DisplayName..":"..entry.Plot)
			if entry.UserId==self.selected then selectedExists=true end
		end
		if not selectedExists then self.selected=nil end
		local key=table.concat(keys,"|")
		if key~=self.rosterKey then
			self.rosterKey=key
			for _,button in pairs(rowButtons) do button:Destroy() end
			rowButtons={}
			for index,entry in ipairs(state.Players or {}) do
				local caption=entry.Username.."\nDisplay: "..entry.DisplayName.."\nID: "..entry.UserId.."\nPlot: "..(entry.Plot~="" and entry.Plot or "NO PLOT ASSIGNED")
				local button=UI.Button(playerList,caption,0,(index-1)*104,351,98,function() self.selected=entry.UserId;highlight() end,C.Card)
				button.TextSize=18
				button.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				rowButtons[entry.UserId]=button
			end
			playerList.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#(state.Players or {})*104)
		end
		highlight()
		statusLabels.PLAYERS.Text=string.format("%d / %d",#(state.Players or {}),state.MaxPlayers or 0)
		local plots=state.Plots
		statusLabels["CLAIMED PLOTS"].Text=plots and plots.Available and string.format("%d / %d",plots.Claimed,plots.Total) or "Unavailable"
		local queueId=state.Weather and state.Weather.QueuedEventId
		queuedLabel.Text=queueId and Events[queueId] and Events[queueId].DisplayName or "None"
		local lines={}
		for _,entry in ipairs(state.Activity or {}) do
			-- Announcements already contain their authoritative username.
			local text=entry.Message:sub(1,8)=="[Admin] " and entry.Message or (entry.Username.." "..entry.Message)
			table.insert(lines,os.date("!%H:%M",entry.Time).."  "..text)
		end
		logText.Text=#lines>0 and table.concat(lines,"\n\n") or "No admin activity yet"
		-- AutomaticSize measures wrapped messages rather than clipping longer entries.
		logText.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(842,0)
		logText.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		logs.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	end
	function self:Tick(weatherState)
		if not self.state then return end
		local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(now-(self.state.ServerStartedAt or now)))
		statusLabels.UPTIME.Text=string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/3600),math.floor(seconds/60)%60,seconds%60)
		local isEvent=weatherState:GetAttribute("Phase")=="Event"
		statusLabels["CURRENT EVENT"].Text=isEvent and (weatherState:GetAttribute("EventName") or "Event") or "Break"
		local deadline=weatherState:GetAttribute(isEvent and "EndsAt" or "BreakEndsAt") or 0
		local left=math.max(0,math.ceil(deadline-now))
		statusLabels["TIME LEFT"].Text=string.format("%02d:%02d",math.floor(left/60),left%60)
		statusLabels["AUTOMATIC WEATHER"].Text=weatherState:GetAttribute("AutomaticPaused") and "Paused" or "Running"
	end
	function self:Destroy() for _,gui in ipairs(self.surfaces) do gui:Destroy() end end
	return self
end

	}, parent)
end

function C.text(parent, props)
	props = props or {}
	props.BackgroundTransparency = props.BackgroundTransparency == nil and 1 or props.BackgroundTransparency
	props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
	props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or Theme.Ink

	new("UITextSizeConstraint", { MinTextSize = math.min(10, props.TextSize), MaxTextSize = props.TextSize }, label)

function C.shadow(parent, offset)
	local shadow = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Shadow", AnchorPoint = parent.AnchorPoint, Position = parent.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset or 7),
		Size = parent.Size, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Shadow, BackgroundTransparency = 0.58,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = math.max(0, parent.ZIndex - 1), Visible = parent.Visible,
	}, parent.Parent)
	C.corner(shadow, 16)
	parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function() shadow.Position = parent.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, offset or 7) end)
	parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function() shadow.Size = parent.Size end)
	parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() shadow.Visible = parent.Visible end)

function C.button(parent, name, text, color, size)

		BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = text, TextColor3 = Theme.White,

		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = 5,

	C.corner(button, 12); C.stroke(button, 3)
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, button)
	local function tween(value, duration) TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(duration or .1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Scale = value }):Play() end
	if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled or UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(1.05, .12) end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(1, .12) end)

	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(.94, .06) end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(UserInputService.MouseEnabled and 1.05 or 1, .09) end)
	return button
end

local function formatNumber(value)
	for _, unit in ipairs({{1e12,"T"},{1e9,"B"},{1e6,"M"},{1e3,"K"}}) do
		if value >= unit[1] then
			local digits = value / unit[1]
			return (digits >= 100 and "%.0f%s" or digits >= 10 and "%.1f%s" or "%.2f%s"):format(digits, unit[2])
		end
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(value))
end

local function showWindow(name)
	local target = windows[name]
	if activeWindow == target then
		target.Close()
		return
	end
	if activeWindow then activeWindow.Close(true) end
	activeWindow = target
	target.CloseVersion += 1
	if target.ScaleTween then target.ScaleTween:Cancel() end
	if target.FadeTween then target.FadeTween:Cancel() end
	target.Root.Visible = true
	target.Root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	target.Scale.Scale = .92
	target.ScaleTween = TweenService:Create(target.Scale, TweenInfo.new(.19, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale=1})
	target.FadeTween = TweenService:Create(target.Root, TweenInfo.new(.16), {BackgroundTransparency=0})
	target.ScaleTween:Play(); target.FadeTween:Play()
end

local function registerWindow(name, title, color)
	local root, closeButton, scale = C.window(windowsFolder, name .. "Window", title, color)
	local record = { Root=root, Scale=scale, CloseVersion=0 }
	function record.Close(immediate)
		if not root.Visible then return end
		record.CloseVersion += 1
		local closeVersion = record.CloseVersion
		if record.ScaleTween then record.ScaleTween:Cancel() end
		if record.FadeTween then record.FadeTween:Cancel() end
		if immediate then root.Visible=false else
			record.ScaleTween = TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale=.92})
			record.FadeTween = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(.14), {BackgroundTransparency=1})
			record.ScaleTween:Play(); record.FadeTween:Play()
			task.delay(.14, function()
				if record.CloseVersion == closeVersion then root.Visible=false; root.BackgroundTransparency=0 end
			end)
		end
		if activeWindow == record then
			activeWindow=nil
		end
	end
	connect(closeButton.Activated, function() record.Close() end)
	windows[name]=record
	contentByWindow[name]=n("Frame", {Name="Content", Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,78), Size=UDim2.new(1,-32,1,-94), BackgroundTransparency=1, ZIndex=21}, root)
	return contentByWindow[name], record
end

function Bridge.Request(action, payload)
	localSignal:Fire(action, payload)
	if action == "UnlockBiome" then
		return Knit.OnStart():andThen(function()
			return Knit.GetService("ProgressionService"):UnlockBiome(payload.BiomeId)
		end):catch(function(err)
			warn("[AnimalKingdomUI] Biome unlock request failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end)
	end
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimalKingdomRemotes")
	local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("UIRequest")
	if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote:FireServer(action, payload)
	else
		warn(string.format("[AnimalKingdomUI] Server integration pending for %s", action))
	end
end

return Bridge

local function make(className, properties, parent)
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	for property, value in pairs(properties) do
		instance[property] = value
	end
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function tween(instance, seconds, properties, style, direction)
	local animation = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(seconds, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), properties)
	table.insert(runningTweens, animation)
	animation.Completed:Connect(function()
		local index = table.find(runningTweens, animation)
		if index then table.remove(runningTweens, index) end
	end)
	animation:Play()
	return animation
end

local function cancelTweens()
	local oldTweens = runningTweens
	runningTweens = {}
	for _, animation in ipairs(oldTweens) do animation:Cancel() end
end

local function formatTime(deadline)
	local seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(deadline - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
end

local function currentScale()
	local size = screen.AbsoluteSize
	return math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 500, size.Y / 330), 0.72, 1)
end

local function cardWidth(compact)
	local width = math.max(320, screen.AbsoluteSize.X)
	if compact then return math.floor(math.min(width - 24, 320, math.max(220, width * (width < 700 and 0.63 or 0.3)))) end
	return math.floor(math.min(600, math.max(260, width * (width < 700 and 0.88 or 0.52)), width - 24))
end

local ARTWORK_ASPECT_RATIO = 1.6
local function imageSize(compact)
	local width = cardWidth(compact)
	return UDim2.fromOffset(width, math.floor(width / ARTWORK_ASPECT_RATIO))
end

local function removeCard(smooth)
	generation += 1
	cancelTweens()
	local card = activeCard
	activeCard = nil
	countdownLabel = nil
	activeKey = nil
	endsAt = 0
	if not smooth then
		-- A Break fade can still be finishing when an admin starts another event.
		for _, child in ipairs(screen:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == "ActiveEventCard" or child.Name == "CustomEventImage" then child:Destroy() end
		end
		return
	end
	if not card then return end
	if DEBUG_UI then print("[WeatherEventUI] Hiding card for Break") end
	local scale = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if card:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		tween(card, 0.22, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
	else
		tween(card, 0.22, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	end
	if scale then tween(scale, 0.22, { Scale = scale.Scale * 0.85 }) end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			tween(descendant, 0.22, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
		elseif descendant:IsA("TextLabel") then
			tween(descendant, 0.22, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") then
			tween(descendant, 0.22, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
		end
	end
	task.delay(0.24, function() card:Destroy() end)
end

	make("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(accent, dark), Rotation = 60 }, imageArea)

		make("ImageLabel", { Name = "EventImage", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Image = imageId, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit }, imageArea)

		local item = make("TextLabel", {

			Text = value, TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

			Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		}, card)

	return card, scale, stroke, imageArea, badge, title, description, effectsLabel, timer

local function createCustomCard(imageId)
	local card = make("ImageLabel", {
		Name = "CustomEventImage", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.46), Size = imageSize(false),
		Image = imageId, ImageTransparency = 0, ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ClipsDescendants = true, Visible = true, ZIndex = 10,
	}, screen)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18) }, card)
	local scale = make("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, card)
	return card, scale
end

local function showEvent(definition, eventId, key, deadline, newEvent)
	removeCard(false)
	activeKey = key
	endsAt = deadline
	local token = generation
	local imageId = EVENT_CARD_IMAGES[eventId]
	if not imageId and DEBUG_UI then warn("[WeatherEventUI] Missing card image for: " .. tostring(eventId)) end
	local custom = imageId ~= nil
	local card, scale, stroke, imageArea, badge, title, description, effectsLabel, timer
	if custom then
		card, scale = createCustomCard(imageId)
		if DEBUG_UI then
			print("[WeatherEventUI] Showing custom card:", eventId, imageId)
		end
	else
		card, scale, stroke, imageArea, badge, title, description, effectsLabel, timer = createCard(definition, deadline)
	end
	activeCard = card
	countdownLabel = timer
	local baseScale = custom and 1 or currentScale()
	if custom and not newEvent then
		card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		card.Position = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 15)
		card.Size = imageSize(true)
		card:SetAttribute("Docked", true)
		if DEBUG_UI then print("[WeatherEventUI] Docking custom card (joined mid-event)") end
		return
	end

	local function dock()
		if token ~= generation then return end
		if custom then
			card:SetAttribute("Docked", true)
			if DEBUG_UI then print("[WeatherEventUI] Docking custom card") end
			tween(card, 0.48, {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 15),
				Size = imageSize(true),
			}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)
			return
		end
		tween(card, 0.42, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 122),
		}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart)
		tween(imageArea, 0.42, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 25), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(65, 65) })
		badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 0)
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 16)
		badge.TextSize = 10
		title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 17)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 27)
		title.TextSize = 18
		description.Visible = false
		effectsLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 46)
		effectsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 35)
		effectsLabel.TextSize = 11
		timer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 81)
		timer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 20)
		timer.TextSize = 13
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		if custom then
			scale.Scale = 0.9
			tween(scale, 0.28, { Scale = baseScale }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
			if token ~= generation then return end
		end
		if newEvent then
			-- Exactly three visible pulses for players present when this event started.
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				if token ~= generation then return end
				tween(scale, 0.28, { Scale = baseScale * 1.055 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine).Completed:Wait()
				if token ~= generation then return end
				if not custom then
					tween(stroke, 0.20, { Transparency = 0.55 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine).Completed:Wait()
					if token ~= generation then return end
				end
				tween(scale, 0.28, { Scale = baseScale }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine).Completed:Wait()
				if token ~= generation then return end
				if not custom then
					tween(stroke, 0.20, { Transparency = 0.12 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine).Completed:Wait()
				end
			end
		else
			if not custom then
				scale.Scale = baseScale * 0.92
				tween(scale, 0.26, { Scale = baseScale }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
			end
		end
		dock()
	end)
end

local function refreshFromState()
	local phase = weatherState:GetAttribute("Phase")
	local eventId = weatherState:GetAttribute("EventId")
	local startedAt = weatherState:GetAttribute("StartedAt")
	local deadline = weatherState:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
	local definition = type(eventId) == "string" and definitions[eventId]
	local valid = phase == "Event" and type(eventId) == "string" and eventId ~= "" and type(startedAt) == "number"
		and type(deadline) == "number" and startedAt > 0 and deadline > startedAt
	if not valid then
		if activeCard then removeCard(phase == "Break") end
		hasInitialSnapshot = true
		return
	end
	local key = eventId .. ":" .. tostring(startedAt)
	if key == activeKey then
		endsAt = deadline
		hasInitialSnapshot = true
		return
	end
	local newEvent = hasInitialSnapshot
	hasInitialSnapshot = true
	if deadline <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return end
	if not definition then
		local eventName = weatherState:GetAttribute("EventName")
		if type(eventName) ~= "string" or eventName == "" then eventName = eventId end
		definition = {
			DisplayName = eventName,
			Description = "An event is active in the kingdom.",
			DisplayEffects = {}, IsSecret = false,
		}
	end
	showEvent(definition, eventId, key, deadline, newEvent)
end

weatherState.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attribute)
	if attribute ~= "Phase" and attribute ~= "EventId" and attribute ~= "StartedAt" and attribute ~= "EndsAt" then return end
	if refreshQueued then return end
	refreshQueued = true
	task.defer(function()
		refreshQueued = false
		refreshFromState()
	end)
end)
refreshFromState()

screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
	if activeCard then
		if activeCard:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			activeCard.Size = imageSize(activeCard:GetAttribute("Docked") == true)
		else
			local scale = activeCard:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if scale then scale.Scale = currentScale() end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while screen.Parent do
		if countdownLabel then
			countdownLabel.Text = "Time Left: " .. formatTime(endsAt)
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

local function formatNumber(value)
	local suffixes = { { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1e6, "M" }, { 1e3, "K" } }
	for _, suffix in ipairs(suffixes) do
		if value >= suffix[1] then return string.format("%.2f%s", value / suffix[1], suffix[2]) end
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(value))
end

local function rounded(parent)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = parent
end

	inventory.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	inventory.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	inventory.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	inventory.ScrollBarThickness = 7
	inventory.Parent = gui
	rounded(inventory)

	inventoryConstraint.MinSize = Vector2.new(250, 180)
	inventoryConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(440, 390)
	inventoryConstraint.Parent = inventory
	local inventoryLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	inventoryLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	inventoryLayout.Parent = inventory

	local renderedSignature = ""
	local function renderInventory(data)
		local displayed = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(data.DisplayedPetIds or {}) do displayed[id] = true end
		local signature = tostring(#(data.OwnedPets or {})) .. ":" .. table.concat(data.DisplayedPetIds or {}, ",")
		if signature == renderedSignature then return end
		renderedSignature = signature
		for _, child in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
		for _, owned in ipairs(data.OwnedPets or {}) do
			local definition = Pets[owned.PetId]
			if definition then
				local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
				button.Name = owned.UniquePetId
				button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 52)
				button.BackgroundColor3 = displayed[owned.UniquePetId] and Color3.fromRGB(241, 188, 61) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 112, 78)
				button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				button.Text = string.format("%s [%s]  %s/s", definition.Name, owned.Mutation, formatNumber(definition.CoinsPerSecond))
				button.TextScaled = true
				button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
				button.Parent = inventory
				rounded(button)
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					SanctuaryService:SetPetDisplayed(owned.UniquePetId, not displayed[owned.UniquePetId])
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent do
			local data = DataController:GetPlayerData()
			if data then
				coins.Text = "Forest Coins\n" .. formatNumber(data.ForestCoins or 0)
				tokens.Text = "Friendship\n" .. formatNumber(data.FriendshipTokens or 0)
				collect.Text = "COLLECT\n" .. formatNumber(data.UncollectedSanctuaryCoins or 0)
				renderInventory(data)
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

	local productionSource = StarterGui:FindFirstChild("AnimalKingdomUI")
	if productionSource or (existing and existing:GetAttribute("ProductionUI")) then return end
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	self:CreateUI()
end

	DataController = Knit.GetController("DataController")
	SanctuaryService = Knit.GetService("SanctuaryService")

local rerubi = require(script.Rerubi)

luaX:init()
local LuaState = {}

getfenv().script = nil

return function(str,env)
	local f,writer,buff,name
	local env = env or getfenv(2)
	local name = (env.script and env.script:GetFullName())
	local ran,error = pcall(function()
		local zio = luaZ:init(luaZ:make_getS(str), nil)
		if not zio then return error() end
		local func = luaY:parser(LuaState, zio, nil, name or "::Adonis::Loadstring::")
		writer, buff = luaU:make_setS()
		luaU:dump(LuaState, func, writer, buff)
		f = rerubi(buff.data, env)
	end)
	
	if ran then
		return f,buff.data
	else
		return nil,error
	end
end
