function WeatherAdminService:KnitStart()
	buildRoom()
	attachCameraLabels()
	weatherState = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WeatherState")
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimalKingdomRemotes")
	if not remotes then
		remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
		remotes.Name = "AnimalKingdomRemotes"
		remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	assert(remotes:IsA("Folder"), "AnimalKingdomRemotes must be a Folder")
	actionRemote = remotes:FindFirstChild("WeatherAdminAction")
	if not actionRemote then
		actionRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		actionRemote.Name = "WeatherAdminAction"
		actionRemote.Parent = remotes
	end
	assert(actionRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "WeatherAdminAction must be a RemoteEvent")
	cameraRemote = remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminCameraControl")
	if not cameraRemote then
		cameraRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		cameraRemote.Name = "AdminCameraControl"
		cameraRemote.Parent = remotes
	end
	assert(cameraRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent"), "AdminCameraControl must be a RemoteEvent")
	cameraRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command, cameraId)
		if not isAuthorized(player) or not isInsideRoom(player) then return end
		if command == "Select" then
			selectCamera(player, cameraId)
		elseif command == "Exit" then
			cameraRemote:FireClient(player, "Close")
		end
	end)
	actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then return end
		dispatch(player, payload.Action, payload.EventId)
	end)
	addCommand("WeatherRoomCommand", "/weatherroom", "/weatheradmin", "Teleport")
	addCommand("WeatherReturnCommand", "/return", "/weatherreturn", "Return")
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAction[player] = nil
		lastCameraAction[player] = nil
		returnCFrames[player] = nil
	end)
	local function watchPlayer(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			-- Respawns use the normal game spawn; no admin-room SpawnLocation is created.
			returnCFrames[player] = nil
			cameraRemote:FireClient(player, "Close")
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(player) end
	task.spawn(function()
		while room.Parent do
			updateBoard()
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

return WeatherAdminService

local function publishState(self)
	-- The folder is created before the first transition; its attributes are the join snapshot.
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("Phase", self.CurrentPhase)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("EventId", self.CurrentEventId)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("EventName", self.CurrentEventId ~= "" and EventDefinitions[self.CurrentEventId].DisplayName or "")
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("StartedAt", self.CurrentEventStartTime)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("EndsAt", self.CurrentEventEndTime)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("BreakEndsAt", self.BreakEndTime)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("AutomaticPaused", self.AutomaticEventsPaused)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("QueuedEventId", self.QueuedEventId)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("QueueRevision", self.QueueRevision)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("TestMode", TEST_MODE)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("BreakDuration", BREAK_DURATION)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("EventDuration", EVENT_DURATION)
end

local function invalidateTimer()
	timerVersion += 1
	return timerVersion
end

function WeatherEventService:OnEventStarted(_definition)
	-- Future server-side effects attach here.
end

function WeatherEventService:OnEventEnded(_definition)
	-- Future server-side cleanup attaches here.
end

function WeatherEventService:GetCurrentState()
	return {
		Phase = self.CurrentPhase,
		EventId = self.CurrentEventId,
		EventName = self.CurrentEventId ~= "" and EventDefinitions[self.CurrentEventId].DisplayName or "",
		StartedAt = self.CurrentEventStartTime,
		EndsAt = self.CurrentEventEndTime,
		BreakEndsAt = self.BreakEndTime,
		AutomaticPaused = self.AutomaticEventsPaused,
		QueuedEventId = self.QueuedEventId,
		QueueRevision = self.QueueRevision,
	}
end

function WeatherEventService:SelectRandomAutomaticEvent()
	local totalWeight = 0
	for id, definition in pairs(EventDefinitions) do
		if definition.IsAutomatic and id ~= self.PreviousAutomaticEventId and definition.Weight > 0 then
			totalWeight += definition.Weight
		end
	end
	assert(totalWeight > 0, "No eligible automatic weather events")
	local roll = random:NextInteger(1, totalWeight)
	for id, definition in pairs(EventDefinitions) do
		if definition.IsAutomatic and id ~= self.PreviousAutomaticEventId and definition.Weight > 0 then
			roll -= definition.Weight
			if roll <= 0 then
				return id
			end
		end
	end
	error("Automatic weather event selection failed")
end

function WeatherEventService:StartBreak()
	assert(started, "WeatherEventService has not started")
	local version = invalidateTimer()
	self.CurrentPhase = "Break"
	self.CurrentEventId = ""
	self.CurrentEventStartTime = 0
	self.CurrentEventEndTime = 0
	self.BreakEndTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + BREAK_DURATION
	publishState(self)
	print("[WeatherEventService] Break started - " .. BREAK_DURATION .. " seconds")
	task.delay(BREAK_DURATION, function()
		if version ~= timerVersion or self.CurrentPhase ~= "Break" then return end
		self.BreakEndTime = 0
		publishState(self)
		if not self.AutomaticEventsPaused then
			self:_StartAutomaticEvent()
		end
	end)
end

function WeatherEventService:StartEvent(eventId, isAutomatic)
	assert(started, "WeatherEventService has not started")
	local definition = EventDefinitions[eventId]
	assert(definition, "Unknown weather event: " .. tostring(eventId))
	if isAutomatic then
		assert(definition.IsAutomatic, "Secret events cannot start automatically")
	end
	local version = invalidateTimer()
	if self.CurrentPhase == "Event" then
		local oldDefinition = EventDefinitions[self.CurrentEventId]
		print("[WeatherEventService] Ending event: " .. oldDefinition.DisplayName)
		self:OnEventEnded(oldDefinition)
	end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local duration = durationFor(definition)
	self.CurrentPhase = "Event"
	self.CurrentEventId = eventId
	self.CurrentEventStartTime = now
	self.CurrentEventEndTime = now + duration
	self.BreakEndTime = 0
	if isAutomatic then
		self.PreviousAutomaticEventId = eventId
	end
	publishState(self)
	print("[WeatherEventService] Starting event: " .. definition.DisplayName .. " - " .. duration .. " seconds")
	self:OnEventStarted(definition)
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if version ~= timerVersion or self.CurrentPhase ~= "Event" then return end
		self:EndCurrentEvent()
	end)
end

function WeatherEventService:_StartAutomaticEvent()
	if self.AutomaticEventsPaused or self.CurrentPhase ~= "Break" then return end
	if self:_StartQueuedEvent() then return end
	self:StartRandomAutomaticEvent()
end

function WeatherEventService:QueueEvent(eventId)
	if type(eventId) ~= "string" or not EventDefinitions[eventId] then return false end
	self.QueuedEventId = eventId
	self.QueueRevision += 1
	publishState(self)
	return true
end

function WeatherEventService:ClearQueue()
	self.QueuedEventId = ""
	self.QueueRevision += 1
	publishState(self)
end

function WeatherEventService:_StartQueuedEvent()
	local eventId = self.QueuedEventId
	if eventId == "" then return false end
	-- Consume before starting so callbacks cannot replay the queued event.
	self.QueuedEventId = ""
	self.QueueRevision += 1
	self:StartEvent(eventId)
	return true
end

function WeatherEventService:StartRandomAutomaticEvent()
	local eventId = self:SelectRandomAutomaticEvent()
	self:StartEvent(eventId, true)
	return eventId
end

function WeatherEventService:EndCurrentEvent()
	if not started or self.CurrentPhase ~= "Event" then return end
	invalidateTimer()
	local definition = EventDefinitions[self.CurrentEventId]
	print("[WeatherEventService] Ending event: " .. definition.DisplayName)
	self:OnEventEnded(definition)
	-- Explicitly queued events follow the current event immediately. An automatic
	-- pause holds the queue until automatic weather is resumed.
	self.CurrentPhase = "Break"
	if not self.AutomaticEventsPaused and self:_StartQueuedEvent() then return end
	self:StartBreak()
end

function WeatherEventService:EmergencyReset()
	invalidateTimer()
	if self.CurrentPhase == "Event" then
		self:OnEventEnded(EventDefinitions[self.CurrentEventId])
	end
	self.QueuedEventId = ""
	self.QueueRevision += 1
	self.AutomaticEventsPaused = false
	-- Publishing Break invokes the existing client visual cleanup; its normal
	-- timer restarts the cycle. No Lighting objects are touched here.
	self:StartBreak()
end

function WeatherEventService:PauseAutomaticEvents()
	if self.AutomaticEventsPaused then return end
	self.AutomaticEventsPaused = true
	publishState(self)
	print("[WeatherEventService] Automatic events paused")
end

function WeatherEventService:ResumeAutomaticEvents()
	if not self.AutomaticEventsPaused then return end
	self.AutomaticEventsPaused = false
	publishState(self)
	print("[WeatherEventService] Automatic events resumed")
	if self.CurrentPhase == "Break" and self.BreakEndTime == 0 then
		self:_StartAutomaticEvent()
	end
end

function WeatherEventService:Start()
	if started then return end
	started = true
	stateFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("WeatherState")
	if not stateFolder then
		stateFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		stateFolder.Name = "WeatherState"
	end
	assert(stateFolder:IsA("Folder"), "WeatherState must be a Folder")
	self:StartBreak()
	stateFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

function WeatherEventService:KnitStart()
	self:Start()
end

return WeatherEventService

local function folder(parent, name)
	local value = parent:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("Folder")
	value.Name = name
	value.Parent = parent
	return value
end

local function part(parent, name, size, position, color)
	local value = Instance.new("Part")
	value.Name = name
	value.Anchored = true
	value.Size = size
	value.Position = position
	value.Color = color
	value.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	value.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	value.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	value.Parent = parent
	return value
end

local function billboard(parent, text, offset, color)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "WorldLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 72)
	gui.StudsOffset = offset
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.MaxDistance = 150
	gui.Parent = parent
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 36, 30)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.Parent = gui
	return gui
end

local function propPart(parent, name, size, cframe, color, material, shape)
	local value = Instance.new("Part")
	value.Name = name
	value.Anchored = true
	value.CanCollide = true
	value.Size = size
	value.CFrame = cframe
	value.Color = color
	value.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	value.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	value.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape then value.Shape = shape end
	value.Parent = parent
	return value
end

local function buildTree(parent, position, style, scale, variant)
	local trunk = propPart(parent, "Trunk", Vector3.new(2.2, 8, 2.2) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4 * scale, 0)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	trunk.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	local crownColor = style.Ground:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), variant * 0.035)
	propPart(parent, "Crown", Vector3.new(7, 7, 7) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 9 * scale, 0)), crownColor, Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	propPart(parent, "Crown", Vector3.new(5, 5, 5) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(2.8, 10 * scale, 0)), crownColor, Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
end

local function buildBiomeProp(parent, biomeId, position, style, scale, variant)
	if biomeId == "Meadow" or biomeId == "Forest" or biomeId == "Jungle" or biomeId == "Prehistoric" then
		buildTree(parent, position, style, scale, variant)
	elseif biomeId == "Desert" then
		local cactus = propPart(parent, "Cactus", Vector3.new(2.4, 9, 2.4) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5 * scale, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(62, 145, 72), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		propPart(parent, "CactusArm", Vector3.new(5, 1.7, 1.7) * scale, cactus.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.7 * scale, 0.5 * scale, 0), cactus.Color, cactus.Material)
	elseif biomeId == "Snow" then
		propPart(parent, "IceSpire", Vector3.new(4, 11, 4) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5.5 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), math.rad(8)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Glass)
	elseif biomeId == "Volcano" then
		propPart(parent, "LavaRock", Vector3.new(7, 5, 7) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, variant, 0), style.Ground, Enum.Material.Slate, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		local glow = propPart(parent, "LavaCrack", Vector3.new(4, 0.35, 1) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5 * scale, 0)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
		glow.CanCollide = false
	elseif biomeId == "Ocean" then
		propPart(parent, "Coral", Vector3.new(2, 8, 2) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(variant % 2 == 0 and 12 or -12)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		propPart(parent, "CoralBranch", Vector3.new(5, 1.5, 1.5) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5 * scale, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 126, 151), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	elseif biomeId == "AncientRuins" then
		propPart(parent, "Pillar", Vector3.new(4, 10, 4) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(variant % 3 * 3), 0, math.rad(variant % 2 * 5)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
		propPart(parent, "Capital", Vector3.new(6, 1.2, 6) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 10 * scale, 0)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
	elseif biomeId == "MagicalForest" then
		local stem = propPart(parent, "MushroomStem", Vector3.new(2.5, 6, 2.5) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 3 * scale, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(236, 220, 203), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		propPart(parent, "MushroomCap", Vector3.new(8, 3, 8) * scale, stem.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4 * scale, 0), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	elseif biomeId == "Sky" then
		local cloud = propPart(parent, "Cloud", Vector3.new(9, 4, 6) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6 * scale, 0)), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		cloud.CanCollide = false
		propPart(parent, "Cloud", Vector3.new(6, 5, 6) * scale, cloud.CFrame * CFrame.new(3 * scale, 1, 0), cloud.Color, cloud.Material, Enum.PartType.Ball).CanCollide = false
	else
		local crystal = propPart(parent, "Crystal", Vector3.new(3.5, 10, 3.5) * scale, CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5 * scale, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), math.rad(variant % 2 == 0 and 8 or -8)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
		crystal.CanCollide = false
	end
end

function WorldService:BuildStaticBiomes(world)
	local blockout = world:FindFirstChild("BiomeBlockout")
	if not blockout then return end
	for biomeIndex, biome in ipairs(Config.Biomes) do
		local biomeModel = blockout:FindFirstChild(biome.Id)
		local platform = biomeModel and biomeModel:FindFirstChild("Platform")
		if platform then
			local style = biomeStyles[biome.Id]
			platform.Color = style.Ground
			platform.Material = style.Material
			biomeModel:SetAttribute("BiomeId", biome.Id)
			local gameplay = folder(biomeModel, "Gameplay")
			gameplay:ClearAllChildren()
			local center = platform.Position + Vector3.new(0, platform.Size.Y / 2, 0)
			local sign = propPart(gameplay, "BiomeSign", Vector3.new(20, 10, 2), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 5, -platform.Size.Z / 2 + 10)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Wood)
			billboard(sign, string.upper(biome.DisplayName), Vector3.new(0, 7, 0), style.Accent)
			local randomizer = Random.new(4700 + biomeIndex)
			for propIndex = 1, 14 do
				local x = randomizer:NextNumber(-platform.Size.X * 0.42, platform.Size.X * 0.42)
				local z = randomizer:NextNumber(-platform.Size.Z * 0.38, platform.Size.Z * 0.38)
				if math.abs(x) > 22 or math.abs(z) > 25 then
					buildBiomeProp(gameplay, biome.Id, center + Vector3.new(x, 0, z), style, randomizer:NextNumber(0.75, 1.35), propIndex)
				end
			end
			for objectIndex = 1, Config.ShakeablesPerBiome do
				local shakeableId = string.format("%s_Shakeable_%02d", biome.Id, objectIndex)
				local definition = Shakeables[shakeableId]
				local angle = (objectIndex - 1) / Config.ShakeablesPerBiome * math.pi * 2
				local glowing = biome.Id == "Volcano" or biome.Id == "MagicalForest" or biome.Id == "Mythical"
				local object = propPart(gameplay, shakeableId, Vector3.new(8, 10, 8), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 42, 5, math.sin(angle) * 36)), style.Accent, glowing and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
				object:SetAttribute("ShakeableId", shakeableId)
				object:SetAttribute("Cost", definition.Cost)
				local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.ActionText = "Pay & Shake"
				prompt.ObjectText = string.format("%d Forest Coins", definition.Cost)
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
				prompt.Parent = object
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
					HarvestService.Client.Shake(HarvestService.Client, player, shakeableId)
				end)
			end
			if biomeIndex == 1 then
				local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
				spawn.Name = "MeadowSpawn"
				spawn.Anchored = true
				spawn.Neutral = true
				spawn.Size = Vector3.new(12, 1, 12)
				spawn.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 18)
				spawn.Color = style.Accent
				spawn.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				spawn.Parent = gameplay
			else
				local inward = Vector3.new(-center.X, 0, -center.Z).Unit
				local gate = propPart(gameplay, "UnlockGate", Vector3.new(18, 14, 3), CFrame.new(center + inward * math.min(platform.Size.X, platform.Size.Z) * 0.39 + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0), center + inward * 10 + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)), style.Accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
				gate.CanCollide = false
				gate:SetAttribute("BiomeId", biome.Id)
				local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.ActionText = "Unlock " .. biome.DisplayName
				prompt.ObjectText = tostring(biome.UnlockCost) .. " Forest Coins"
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
				prompt.Parent = gate
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
					ProgressionService.Client.UnlockBiome(ProgressionService.Client, player, biome.Id)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

function WorldService:BuildWorld()
	-- The biome blockout is mapped by Rojo. Runtime objects still need a stable
	-- parent so systems such as NumNomService can add temporary world content.
	local existingWorld = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
	if existingWorld and existingWorld:FindFirstChild("BiomeBlockout") then
		folder(existingWorld, "Runtime")
		folder(workspace, "Sanctuaries")
		self:BuildStaticBiomes(existingWorld)
		return
	end

	-- Fall back to a generated world when the static blockout is not present.
	local world = folder(workspace, "World")
	local biomesFolder = folder(world, "Biomes")
	folder(world, "Runtime")
	folder(workspace, "Sanctuaries")
	local plaza = part(world, "CentralPlaza", Vector3.new(300, 0.1, 300), Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), Color3.fromRGB(213, 198, 153))
	plaza.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
	local welcome = part(world, "WelcomeSign", Vector3.new(24, 12, 2), Vector3.new(0, 7, -135), Color3.fromRGB(65, 99, 72))
	billboard(welcome, "ANIMAL KINGDOM", Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 239, 154))
	for biomeIndex, biome in ipairs(Config.Biomes) do
		local biomeFolder = folder(biomesFolder, biome.Id)
		biomeFolder:SetAttribute("BiomeId", biome.Id)
		local slot = biomeSlots[biomeIndex]
		local center = Vector3.new(slot.X * biomeSpacing, 0.05, slot.Y * biomeSpacing)
		local style = biomeStyles[biome.Id]
		local biomeColor = style.Ground
		local ground = part(biomeFolder, "Ground", Vector3.new(150, 0.1, 150), center, biomeColor)
		ground.Material = style.Material
		local borderY = center.Y + 0.45
		local north = part(biomeFolder, "NorthBorder", Vector3.new(150, 0.8, 1.5), Vector3.new(center.X, borderY, center.Z - 74.25), style.Accent)
		local south = part(biomeFolder, "SouthBorder", Vector3.new(150, 0.8, 1.5), Vector3.new(center.X, borderY, center.Z + 74.25), style.Accent)
		local west = part(biomeFolder, "WestBorder", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.8, 147), Vector3.new(center.X - 74.25, borderY, center.Z), style.Accent)
		local east = part(biomeFolder, "EastBorder", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.8, 147), Vector3.new(center.X + 74.25, borderY, center.Z), style.Accent)
		for _, border in ipairs({ north, south, west, east }) do
			border.Material = (biome.Id == "Volcano" or biome.Id == "MagicalForest" or biome.Id == "Mythical") and Enum.Material.Neon or style.Material
			border.CanCollide = false
		end
		local sign = part(biomeFolder, "BiomeSign", Vector3.new(16, 9, 1), center + Vector3.new(-61, 5.5, -61), style.Accent)
		billboard(sign, string.upper(biome.DisplayName), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), style.Accent)
		if biomeIndex == 1 then
			local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
			spawn.Name = "MeadowSpawn"
			spawn.Anchored = true
			spawn.Neutral = true
			spawn.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
			spawn.Position = center + Vector3.new(-45, 2, -20)
			spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(244, 235, 133)
			spawn.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			spawn.Parent = biomeFolder
		elseif biome.UnlockCost > 0 then
			local inward = Vector3.new(-center.X, 0, -center.Z).Unit
			local gate = part(biomeFolder, "UnlockGate", Vector3.new(12, 12, 3), center + inward * 62 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), biomeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35))
			gate.CanCollide = false
			gate:SetAttribute("BiomeId", biome.Id)
			local unlockPrompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			unlockPrompt.ActionText = "Unlock " .. biome.DisplayName
			unlockPrompt.ObjectText = tostring(biome.UnlockCost) .. " Forest Coins"
			unlockPrompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
			unlockPrompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
			unlockPrompt.Parent = gate
			unlockPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				ProgressionService.Client.UnlockBiome(ProgressionService.Client, player, biome.Id)
			end)
		end
		for shakeableId, definition in pairs(Shakeables) do

				prompt.ActionText = "Pay & Shake"
				prompt.ObjectText = string.format("%s Forest Coins", definition.Cost)
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
				prompt.Parent = object
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)

function WorldService:CreateSanctuary(player)
	local sanctuaries = folder(workspace, "Sanctuaries")
	local existing = sanctuaries:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = tostring(player.UserId)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	model.Parent = sanctuaries
	local slot = nextSanctuarySlot
	nextSanctuarySlot += 1
	local origin = Vector3.new((slot % 2) * 78 - 39, 0.15, math.floor(slot / 2) * 68 - 34)
	local base = part(model, "SanctuaryFloor", Vector3.new(72, 0.1, 60), origin, Color3.fromRGB(104, 180, 82))
	base.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
	for index = 1, Config.MaxDisplayedPets do
		local row = math.floor((index - 1) / 10)
		local column = (index - 1) % 10
		local spot = part(model, string.format("DisplaySpot%02d", index), Vector3.new(5, 0.4, 5), origin + Vector3.new(-31.5 + column * 7, 0.7, -22 + row * 7), Color3.fromRGB(196, 231, 170))
		spot:SetAttribute("DisplayIndex", index)
	end
	local pad = part(model, "CollectionPad", Vector3.new(12, 1, 8), origin + Vector3.new(0, 1, 25), Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 75))
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Collect Forest Coins"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Shared Sanctuary Income"
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = pad
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggeringPlayer)
		if triggeringPlayer == player then SanctuaryService.Client.Collect(SanctuaryService.Client, player) end
	end)
	task.defer(function()
		ProfileService:WaitUntilProfileLoaded(player)
		if player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			self:RefreshDisplays(player)
		end
	end)
end

function WorldService:RefreshDisplays(player)
	local sanctuaries = workspace:FindFirstChild("Sanctuaries")
	local sanctuary = sanctuaries and sanctuaries:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	if not sanctuary or not data then return end
	local visuals = sanctuary:FindFirstChild("DisplayedPets") or Instance.new("Folder")
	visuals.Name = "DisplayedPets"
	visuals.Parent = sanctuary
	visuals:ClearAllChildren()
	local ownedById = {}
	for _, owned in ipairs(data.OwnedPets) do ownedById[owned.UniquePetId] = owned end
	for index, uniqueId in ipairs(data.DisplayedPetIds) do
		if index > Config.MaxDisplayedPets then break end
		local owned = ownedById[uniqueId]
		local definition = owned and Pets[owned.PetId]
		local mutation = owned and Mutations[owned.Mutation]
		local spot = sanctuary:FindFirstChild(string.format("DisplaySpot%02d", index))
		if definition and mutation and spot then
			local visual = part(visuals, uniqueId, Vector3.new(3.2, 3.2, 3.2), spot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2), mutation.Color)
			visual.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			visual.CanCollide = false
			visual:SetAttribute("PetId", owned.PetId)
			visual:SetAttribute("Mutation", owned.Mutation)
			local label = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			label.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
			label.AlwaysOnTop = true
			label.Parent = visual
			local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			textLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
			textLabel.TextScaled = true
			textLabel.Text = definition.Name
			textLabel.Parent = label
		end
	end
end

function SanctuaryService:GetIncome(data)
	local ownedById = {}
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.OwnedPets) do ownedById[pet.UniquePetId] = pet end
	local income = 0
	for _, uniqueId in ipairs(data.DisplayedPetIds) do
		local owned = ownedById[uniqueId]
		local definition = owned and Pets[owned.PetId]
		if definition then income += definition.CoinsPerSecond end
	end
	return income
end

function SanctuaryService:Accrue(player)
	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local lastOnline = lastOnlineAccrual[player]
	local weightedSeconds
	if lastOnline then
		weightedSeconds = EventModifierService:GetCoinWeightedSeconds(lastOnline, now)
	else
		-- Split saved offline time from time spent online before the first tick.
		local sessionStart = joinedAt[player] or now
		local offlineSeconds = math.clamp(sessionStart - (data.SanctuaryIncomeUpdatedAt or sessionStart), 0, 86_400)
		weightedSeconds = offlineSeconds + EventModifierService:GetCoinWeightedSeconds(sessionStart, now)
	end
	lastOnlineAccrual[player] = now
	if weightedSeconds > 0 then
		DataService:Set(player, "UncollectedSanctuaryCoins", data.UncollectedSanctuaryCoins + self:GetIncome(data) * weightedSeconds)
		DataService:Set(player, "SanctuaryIncomeUpdatedAt", now)
	end
end

function SanctuaryService.Client:SetPetDisplayed(player, uniquePetId, displayed)
	if type(uniquePetId) ~= "string" or type(displayed) ~= "boolean" or not Guard.RateLimit(player, "Display", 0.15) then return false end
	SanctuaryService:Accrue(player)
	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	if not data or not PetService:FindOwned(data, uniquePetId) then return false end
	local list = table.clone(data.DisplayedPetIds)
	local found
	for index, id in ipairs(list) do if id == uniquePetId then found = index break end end
	if displayed and not found then
		if #list >= Config.MaxDisplayedPets then return false end
		table.insert(list, uniquePetId)
	elseif not displayed and found then table.remove(list, found) end
	return DataService:Set(player, "DisplayedPetIds", list)
end

function SanctuaryService.Client:Collect(player)
	if not Guard.RateLimit(player, "Collect", 0.5) then return 0 end
	local sanctuaries = workspace:FindFirstChild("Sanctuaries")
	local sanctuary = sanctuaries and sanctuaries:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
	local collectionPad = sanctuary and sanctuary:FindFirstChild("CollectionPad")
	if not collectionPad or not Guard.IsNear(player, collectionPad, 16) then return 0 end
	SanctuaryService:Accrue(player)
	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	local amount = data and math.floor(data.UncollectedSanctuaryCoins) or 0
	if amount <= 0 then return 0 end
	DataService:Set(player, "UncollectedSanctuaryCoins", 0)
	CurrencyService:Add(player, "ForestCoins", amount)
	return amount
end

function SanctuaryService:KnitStart()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) joinedAt[player] = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastOnlineAccrual[player] = nil
		joinedAt[player] = nil
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do joinedAt[player] = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.IncomeTickSeconds)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do self:Accrue(player) end
		end
	end)
end

	Vector2.new(-1.5, -1.5), Vector2.new(-0.5, -1.5), Vector2.new(0.5, -1.5), Vector2.new(1.5, -1.5),
	Vector2.new(1.5, -0.5), Vector2.new(1.5, 0.5), Vector2.new(1.5, 1.5), Vector2.new(0.5, 1.5),

function NumNomService:Collect(player, instance)
	if not Guard.RateLimit(player, "NumNom", 0.75) or not Guard.IsNear(player, instance, 16) then return false end
	local id = instance:GetAttribute("NumNomId")
	local definition = type(id) == "string" and Database[id]
	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	if not definition or not data or not data.UnlockedBiomes[definition.Biome] then return false end
	local index = table.clone(data.NumNomIndex)
	local firstDiscovery = not index[id]
	index[id] = (index[id] or 0) + 1
	DataService:Set(player, "NumNomIndex", index)
	CurrencyService:Add(player, "FriendshipTokens", definition.FriendshipTokens)
	if firstDiscovery then
		local decorations = table.clone(data.UnlockedDecorations)
		decorations[definition.UnlockId] = true
		DataService:Set(player, "UnlockedDecorations", decorations)
	end
	activeById[instance] = nil
	instance:Destroy()
	return true
end

function NumNomService:SpawnOne()
	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, candidate in pairs(Database) do totalWeight += candidate.SpawnWeight end
	local roll = random:NextInteger(1, totalWeight)
	local definition
	for _, candidate in pairs(Database) do
		roll -= candidate.SpawnWeight
		if roll <= 0 then definition = candidate break end
	end
	if not definition then return end
	local runtime = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") and workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Runtime")
	if not runtime then return end
	local object = Instance.new("Part")
	object.Name = definition.NumNomId
	object.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	object.Size = Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5)
	object.Anchored = true
	local blockout = workspace.World:FindFirstChild("BiomeBlockout")
	local biomeModel = blockout and blockout:FindFirstChild(definition.Biome)
	local platform = biomeModel and biomeModel:FindFirstChild("Platform")
	if platform then
		object.Position = platform.Position + Vector3.new(
			random:NextNumber(-platform.Size.X * 0.4, platform.Size.X * 0.4),
			3,
			random:NextNumber(-platform.Size.Z * 0.4, platform.Size.Z * 0.4)
		)
	else
		local biomeIndex = 1
		for index, biome in ipairs(require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedSource.Datas.AnimalKingdomConfig).Biomes) do
			if biome.Id == definition.Biome then biomeIndex = index break end
		end
		local slot = biomeSlots[biomeIndex]
		object.Position = Vector3.new(
			slot.X * biomeSpacing + random:NextNumber(-60, 60),
			2,
			slot.Y * biomeSpacing + random:NextNumber(-60, 60)
		)
	end
	object.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 153, 204)
	object:SetAttribute("NumNomId", definition.NumNomId)
	object:SetAttribute("BiomeId", definition.Biome)
	object.Parent = runtime
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Befriend"
	prompt.ObjectText = definition.Name
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = object
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) self:Collect(player, object) end)
	activeById[object] = true
end

function NumNomService:KnitStart()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(5)
			local count = 0
			for object in pairs(activeById) do if object.Parent then count += 1 else activeById[object] = nil end end
			if count < math.max(12, #Players:GetPlayers() * 6) then self:SpawnOne() end
		end
	end)
end

local function rollMutation()
	local total = 0
	for id, entry in pairs(Mutations) do total += EventModifierService:GetMutationWeight(id, entry.Weight) end
	if total <= 0 then return "Normal" end
	local roll = random:NextNumber(0, total)
	for id, entry in pairs(Mutations) do
		roll -= EventModifierService:GetMutationWeight(id, entry.Weight)
		if roll < 0 then return id end
	end
	return "Normal"
end

local function rollPet(results)
	local total = 0
	for _, petId in ipairs(results) do
		total += EventModifierService:GetPetRollWeight(Pets[petId], 1)
	end
	if total <= 0 then return nil end
	local roll = random:NextNumber(0, total)
	for _, petId in ipairs(results) do
		roll -= EventModifierService:GetPetRollWeight(Pets[petId], 1)
		if roll < 0 then return petId end
	end
	return results[#results]
end

function HarvestService.Client:Shake(player, shakeableId)
	if type(shakeableId) ~= "string" or not Guard.RateLimit(player, "Shake", Config.ShakeCooldown) then return nil end
	local definition = Shakeables[shakeableId]
	local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")

	local data = DataService:Get(player)
	if not definition or not instance or not data or not data.UnlockedBiomes[definition.Biome] then return nil end
	if not Guard.IsNear(player, instance, Config.InteractionDistance) then return nil end
	if not CurrencyService:Spend(player, "ForestCoins", definition.Cost) then return nil end
	local petId = rollPet(definition.Results)
	if not petId then return nil end
	return PetService:Grant(player, petId, rollMutation())

local Events = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.EventDefinitions)
local modules = ServerScriptService.AdminCommandCenter

local PlotStatus = require(modules.PlotStatus)
local Teleports = require(modules.Teleports)

local ActivityLog = require(modules.ActivityLog)

local Service = Knit.CreateService({Name="AdminCommandService", Client={}})
local WeatherAdmin, Weather
local requestRemote, responseRemote, stateRemote, announcementRemote, cameraRemote
local activity = ActivityLog.new(Definitions.ActivityLimit)
local pending, busy, lastAnnouncement, roomPresence, spectators, respawning = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local announcementBusy = false
local lastBroadcast = -math.huge
local startedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - time()
local destinationNames = {}
for _, destination in ipairs(Definitions.Destinations) do destinationNames[destination.Id] = destination.DisplayName end

local function reply(player, message, ok)
	if player.Parent == Players then responseRemote:FireClient(player, {Kind="Result", Message=message, Success=ok == true}) end
end

local function record(player, message)
	activity:Add(player, message)
end

local function stopSpectating(admin, reason)
	local session = spectators[admin]
	if not session then return end
	spectators[admin] = nil
	if session.Connection then session.Connection:Disconnect() end
	if session.Root then pcall(admin.RemoveReplicationFocus, admin, session.Root) end
	record(admin, "stopped spectating " .. session.Target.Name)
	if admin.Parent == Players then responseRemote:FireClient(admin, {Kind="SpectateStop", Reason=reason}) end
end

local function startSpectating(admin, target)
	if admin == target then reply(admin, "SELECT ANOTHER PLAYER", false); return end
	local character = target.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then reply(admin, "TARGET CHARACTER NOT READY", false); return end
	stopSpectating(admin)
	local session = {Target=target, Root=root}
	spectators[admin] = session
	-- Keep the distant subject replicated while the admin remains in the room.
	local focusOk = pcall(admin.AddReplicationFocus, admin, root)
	if workspace.StreamingEnabled and not focusOk then
		spectators[admin] = nil
		reply(admin, "SPECTATE STREAMING UNAVAILABLE", false)
		return
	end
	session.Connection = target.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() stopSpectating(admin, "Target respawned") end)
	cameraRemote:FireClient(admin, "Close")
	responseRemote:FireClient(admin, {Kind="SpectateStart", TargetUserId=target.UserId, Position=root.Position})
	record(admin, "started spectating " .. target.Name)
end

local function confirmation(player, payload, title)
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	pending[player] = {Token=token, Payload=table.clone(payload), Expires=os.clock()+Definitions.ConfirmationLifetime, QueueRevision=Weather.QueueRevision}
	responseRemote:FireClient(player, {Kind="Confirm", Token=token, Title=title, Lifetime=Definitions.ConfirmationLifetime})
end

local function sendState(player, roster, plots)
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, {
		Authorized=true, InRoom=WeatherAdmin:IsInsideRoom(player), Players=roster, MaxPlayers=Players.MaxPlayers,
		ServerStartedAt=startedAt, Plots=plots, Weather=Weather:GetCurrentState(), Activity=activity:Snapshot(),
	})
end

local function snapshot()
	local plotInfo, plots = PlotStatus.GetSnapshot()
	local roster = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local plot = PlotStatus.GetPlayerPlot(player, plots)
		table.insert(roster, {Username=player.Name, DisplayName=player.DisplayName, UserId=player.UserId, Plot=plot and plot.Name or ""})
	end
	table.sort(roster, function(a,b) return a.Username:lower() < b.Username:lower() end)
	return roster, plotInfo
end

local function broadcastAnnouncement(player, raw)
	local message = Policy.SanitizeMessage(raw, Definitions.MaxAnnouncementCharacters)
	if not message then reply(player, "ENTER A MESSAGE OF 1–150 CHARACTERS", false); return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if announcementBusy or now-lastBroadcast < 2 or (lastAnnouncement[player] and now-lastAnnouncement[player] < 5) then
		reply(player, "PLEASE WAIT BEFORE SENDING ANOTHER ANNOUNCEMENT", false)
		return
	end
	lastAnnouncement[player] = now
	announcementBusy = true
	local ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		local result = TextService:FilterStringAsync(message, player.UserId, Enum.TextFilterContext.PublicChat)
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	announcementBusy = false
	if not ok or type(filtered) ~= "string" or not filtered:match("%S") then
		reply(player, "TEXT FILTER UNAVAILABLE — announcement was not sent", false)
		return
	end
	-- Filtering yields. Revalidate authority and membership before broadcasting.
	if player.Parent ~= Players or not WeatherAdmin:IsAuthorized(player) or not WeatherAdmin:IsInsideRoom(player) then return end
	lastBroadcast = os.clock()
	local formattedMessage = string.format('[Admin] "%s": "%s"', player.Name, filtered)
	announcementRemote:FireAllClients({Message=formattedMessage})
	record(player, formattedMessage)
	print(formattedMessage)
	reply(player, "ANNOUNCEMENT SENT", true)
end

local function execute(player, payload, confirmed)
	local action = payload.Action
	if action == "GetState" then sendState(player, snapshot()); return end
	if action == "StopSpectating" then stopSpectating(player); return end
	if action == "Teleport" and payload.Destination == "AdminRoom" then
		local ok, reason = Teleports.ToDestination(player, "AdminRoom", WeatherAdmin)
		if ok then stopSpectating(player); record(player, "teleported to Admin Room") end
		reply(player, ok and "RETURNED TO ADMIN ROOM" or reason, ok)
		return
	end
	if not WeatherAdmin:IsInsideRoom(player) then reply(player, "RETURN TO ADMIN ROOM TO USE THIS CONTROL", false); return end
	if action == "Confirm" then
		local request = pending[player]
		pending[player] = nil
		if not request or request.Token ~= payload.Token or os.clock() > request.Expires then reply(player, "CONFIRMATION EXPIRED", false); return end
		if request.Payload.Action == "QueueEvent" and request.QueueRevision ~= Weather.QueueRevision then
			reply(player, "QUEUE CHANGED — select the event again", false)
			return
		end
		execute(player, request.Payload, true)
		return
	end
	if action == "Announce" then broadcastAnnouncement(player, payload.Message); return end
	if action == "QueueEvent" then
		if not confirmed and Weather.QueuedEventId ~= "" then
			confirmation(player, payload, "REPLACE " .. Events[Weather.QueuedEventId].DisplayName:upper() .. " WITH " .. Events[payload.EventId].DisplayName:upper() .. "?")
			return
		end
		if Weather:QueueEvent(payload.EventId) then
			record(player, "queued " .. Events[payload.EventId].DisplayName)
			reply(player, "EVENT QUEUED — current event continues", true)
		end
		return
	end
	if action == "ClearQueue" then
		Weather:ClearQueue()
		record(player, "cleared event queue")
		reply(player, "QUEUE CLEARED", true)
		return
	end
	if action == "EmergencyReset" then
		if not confirmed then confirmation(player, payload, "RESET WEATHER?\nEnds the event, clears the queue, and resumes the normal cycle."); return end
		Weather:EmergencyReset()
		record(player, "performed emergency weather reset")
		reply(player, "WEATHER RESET — normal cycle resumed", true)
		return
	end
	if action == "Teleport" then
		local ok, reason = Teleports.ToDestination(player, payload.Destination, WeatherAdmin)
		if ok then
			stopSpectating(player)
			cameraRemote:FireClient(player, "Close")
			record(player, "teleported to " .. destinationNames[payload.Destination])
		end
		reply(player, ok and "TELEPORTED" or reason, ok)
		return
	end
	local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(payload.TargetUserId)
	if not target or target.Parent ~= Players then reply(player, "PLAYER LEFT THE SERVER", false); return end
	if action == "SpectatePlayer" then startSpectating(player,target); return end
	if action == "RespawnPlayer" then
		if not confirmed then confirmation(player, payload, "RESPAWN " .. target.Name .. "?"); return end
		if respawning[target] then reply(player, "PLAYER IS ALREADY RESPAWNING", false); return end
		respawning[target] = true
		local ok = pcall(target.LoadCharacterAsync, target)
		respawning[target] = nil
		if ok then record(player, "respawned " .. target.Name) end
		reply(player, ok and "PLAYER RESPAWNED" or "RESPAWN FAILED — try again", ok)
		return
	end
	local ok, reason, message
	if action == "TeleportToPlayer" then
		ok, reason = Teleports.ToPlayer(player, target)
		message = "teleported to " .. target.Name
	elseif action == "TeleportToPlot" then
		ok, reason = Teleports.ToPlot(player, target)
		message = "teleported to " .. target.Name .. "'s plot"
	elseif action == "ReturnPlayerToPlot" then
		ok, reason = Teleports.ToPlot(target, target)
		message = "returned " .. target.Name .. " to their plot"
	elseif action == "BringPlayer" then
		if player == target then reply(player, "SELECT ANOTHER PLAYER", false); return end
		ok, reason = Teleports.ToPlayer(target, player)
		message = "brought " .. target.Name .. " to Admin Room"
	end
	if ok then
		record(player, message)
		if action == "TeleportToPlayer" or action == "TeleportToPlot" or player == target then
			stopSpectating(player)
			cameraRemote:FireClient(player, "Close")
		end
	end
	reply(player, ok and "ACTION COMPLETE" or reason or "ACTION UNAVAILABLE", ok)
end

function Service:KnitInit()
	WeatherAdmin = Knit.GetService("WeatherAdminService")
	Weather = Knit.GetService("WeatherEventService")
end

function Service:KnitStart()
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WeatherState")
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AnimalKingdomRemotes")
	cameraRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("AdminCameraControl")
	local function remote(name)
		local object = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not object then object = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); object.Name=name; object.Parent=remotes end
		assert(object:IsA("RemoteEvent"), name .. " must be a RemoteEvent")
		return object
	end
	requestRemote = remote("AdminCommandRequest")
	responseRemote = remote("AdminCommandResponse")
	stateRemote = remote("AdminCommandState")
	announcementRemote = remote("GlobalAnnouncement")
	local validate, forget = Policy.new(function(player) return WeatherAdmin:IsAuthorized(player) end, Definitions, Events)
	requestRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, payload, ...)
		if busy[player] or not validate(player, payload, ...) then return end
		if player.Parent ~= Players then return end
		busy[player] = true
		local ok, err = pcall(execute, player, payload, false)
		busy[player] = nil
		if not ok then
			warn("[AdminCommand] Request failed: " .. tostring(err))
			reply(player, "ACTION FAILED — please try again", false)
		end
	end)
	WeatherAdmin.ActionRecorded.Event:Connect(record)
	-- A Phase 1 camera selection ends spectating without changing that controller.
	cameraRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command)
		if (command == "Select" or command == "Exit") and WeatherAdmin:IsAuthorized(player) then stopSpectating(player) end
	end)
	local function watch(player)
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() stopSpectating(player, "Admin respawned"); pending[player] = nil end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watch(player) end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if roomPresence[player] then record(player, "left Admin Room (disconnected)") end
		stopSpectating(player)
		for admin, session in pairs(spectators) do if session.Target == player then stopSpectating(admin, "Player left the server") end end
		pending[player], busy[player], lastAnnouncement[player], roomPresence[player], respawning[player] = nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
		forget(player)
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local currentRoom
		while true do
			local room = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeatherAdminRoom")
			if room and room ~= currentRoom and room:FindFirstChild("BackWall") then
				local panels, issue = RoomPanels.Attach(room)
				if panels then currentRoom=room else warn("[AdminCommand] " .. issue); currentRoom=room end
			end
			local roster, plots = snapshot()
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if WeatherAdmin:IsAuthorized(player) then
					local inside = WeatherAdmin:IsInsideRoom(player)
					if inside ~= (roomPresence[player] == true) then
						record(player, inside and "entered Admin Room" or "left Admin Room")
						roomPresence[player] = inside
					end
					if not inside then stopSpectating(player, "Left Admin Room"); pending[player] = nil end
					sendState(player, roster, plots)
				else
					stopSpectating(player, "Authorization changed")
					pending[player] = nil
					stateRemote:FireClient(player, {Authorized=false})
				end
			end
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
end

return Service

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Guard = {}
local calls = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

function Guard.IsPlayer(player)
	return typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") and player:IsDescendantOf(Players)
end

function Guard.RateLimit(player, key, interval)
	if not Guard.IsPlayer(player) or type(key) ~= "string" or type(interval) ~= "number" then return false end
	local now = os.clock()
	local playerCalls = calls[player] or {}
	calls[player] = playerCalls
	if now - (playerCalls[key] or 0) < interval then return false end
	playerCalls[key] = now
	return true
end

function Guard.IsNear(player, instance, maxDistance)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not instance or not instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	local position = instance:IsA("Model") and instance:GetPivot().Position or instance.Position
	return (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end

return Guard

local PlotLocator = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlotLocator)
local PlotStatus = {}

-- Read the ownership attributes maintained by AK_PlotAssignment. Never assign,
-- initialize, or repair a plot from the admin tools.
function PlotStatus.GetSnapshot()
	local plots = PlotLocator.getPlots()
	local claimed = 0
	for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
		if type(plot:GetAttribute("Claimed")) ~= "boolean" or type(plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")) ~= "number" then
			return {Available = false}, plots
		end
		if plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") then claimed += 1 end
	end
	return {Available = #plots > 0, Claimed = claimed, Total = #plots}, plots
end

function PlotStatus.GetPlayerPlot(player, plots)
	for _, plot in ipairs(plots or PlotLocator.getPlots()) do
		if plot:GetAttribute("Claimed") == true and plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			return plot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlotStatus.GetSpawn(plot)
	for _, name in ipairs({"PlotSpawn", "PlayerSpawn", "SpawnPoint", "Spawn", "SpawnLocation"}) do
		local marker = plot:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if marker and marker:IsA("BasePart") then return marker end
	end
	return nil
end

return PlotStatus

local Policy = {}
local targetActions = {TeleportToPlayer=true, TeleportToPlot=true, ReturnPlayerToPlot=true, BringPlayer=true, RespawnPlayer=true, SpectatePlayer=true}
local simpleActions = {GetState=true, StopSpectating=true, ClearQueue=true, EmergencyReset=true}

function Policy.SanitizeMessage(message, maxCharacters)
	if type(message) ~= "string" or #message > maxCharacters * 4 then return nil end
	local count = utf8.len(message)
	if not count or count > maxCharacters then return nil end
	local output = {}
	for _, code in utf8.codes(message) do
		local whitespace = code <= 32 or code == 127 or code == 160 or code == 0x1680
			or (code >= 0x2000 and code <= 0x200F) or code == 0x2028 or code == 0x2029
			or code == 0x202F or code == 0x205F or code == 0x3000 or code == 0xFEFF
		table.insert(output, whitespace and " " or utf8.char(code))
	end
	local clean = table.concat(output):gsub("%s+", " "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	return clean ~= "" and clean or nil
end

function Policy.Validate(payload, definitions, events)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.Action) ~= "string" or #payload.Action > 32 then return false end
	local action = payload.Action
	local fields = {Action=true}
	if targetActions[action] then
		fields.TargetUserId = true
		local id = payload.TargetUserId
		-- Negative Studio test IDs are valid; the service must still resolve an actual Player.
		if type(id) ~= "number" or id ~= id or math.abs(id) > 2^53 or id % 1 ~= 0 then return false end
	elseif action == "Teleport" then
		fields.Destination = true
		local valid = false
		for _, destination in ipairs(definitions.Destinations) do
			if destination.Id == payload.Destination then valid = true; break end
		end
		if not valid then return false end
	elseif action == "QueueEvent" then
		fields.EventId = true
		if type(payload.EventId) ~= "string" or #payload.EventId > 40 or not events[payload.EventId] then return false end
	elseif action == "Announce" then
		fields.Message = true
		if not Policy.SanitizeMessage(payload.Message, definitions.MaxAnnouncementCharacters) then return false end
	elseif action == "Confirm" then
		fields.Token = true
		if type(payload.Token) ~= "string" or #payload.Token ~= 36 then return false end
	elseif not simpleActions[action] then
		return false
	end
	for key in pairs(payload) do if not fields[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Limits are charged before authorization can yield on a group lookup.
function Policy.new(authorize, definitions, events, clock)
	local previous = {}
	clock = clock or os.clock
	return function(player, payload, ...)
		if select("#", ...) ~= 0 then return false end
		local now = clock()
		if previous[player] and now - previous[player] < 0.35 then return false end
		previous[player] = now
		if not authorize(player) then return false end
		return Policy.Validate(payload, definitions, events)
	end, function(player) previous[player] = nil end
end

return Policy

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local server = script.Parent.Parent
local Landing = require(server.BiomeTeleport.Landing)
local BiomeDestinations = require(server.BiomeTeleport.Destinations)
local PlotLocator = require(server.PlotLocator)
local PlotStatus = require(script.Parent.PlotStatus)
local Teleports = {}

local function body(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or root.Anchored or humanoid.SeatPart then return nil end
	return character, root, humanoid
end

function Teleports.Near(player, anchor, excludeCharacter)
	local character, root, humanoid = body(player)
	if not character then return false, "CHARACTER NOT READY — stand up and try again" end
	local _, bounds = character:GetBoundingBox()
	local size = Vector3.new(math.max(6, bounds.X), math.max(8, bounds.Y + 2), math.max(6, bounds.Z))
	local excluded = {character}
	if excludeCharacter then table.insert(excluded, excludeCharacter) end
	local ray = RaycastParams.new()
	ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	ray.RespectCanCollide = true
	local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
	overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
	local offsets = {Vector3.new(4,0,0), Vector3.new(-4,0,0), Vector3.new(0,0,6), Vector3.new(0,0,-6), Vector3.new(8,0,0), Vector3.new(-8,0,0), Vector3.new(0,0,10), Vector3.new(0,0,-10), Vector3.zero}
	for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
		local point = anchor:PointToWorldSpace(offset)
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0,12,0), Vector3.new(0,-48,0), ray)
		if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.95 or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water then continue end
		local center = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0,size.Y / 2 + 0.3,0)
		local blocked = false
		for _, part in ipairs(Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(center), size, overlap)) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if part.CanCollide or (model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then blocked = true; break end
		end
		if blocked then continue end
		for _, corner in ipairs({Vector3.new(-size.X/2,0,-size.Z/2),Vector3.new(size.X/2,0,-size.Z/2),Vector3.new(-size.X/2,0,size.Z/2),Vector3.new(size.X/2,0,size.Z/2)}) do
			local support = Workspace:Raycast(hit.Position + corner + Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-4,0),ray)
			if not support or support.Normal.Y < 0.95 or support.Material == Enum.Material.Water then blocked = true; break end
		end
		if blocked then continue end
		local position = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, math.max(4, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 1), 0)
		local look = Vector3.new(anchor.LookVector.X,0,anchor.LookVector.Z)
		if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
		local pivotOffset = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(character:GetPivot())
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(position,position+look)*pivotOffset)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		return true
	end
	return false, "NO SAFE LANDING — clear the destination and try again"
end

function Teleports.ToPlayer(player, target)
	local character, root = body(target)
	if not character then return false, "TARGET CHARACTER NOT READY" end
	return Teleports.Near(player, root.CFrame, character)
end

function Teleports.ToPlot(player, owner)
	local plot = PlotStatus.GetPlayerPlot(owner)
	if not plot then return false, "NO PLOT ASSIGNED" end
	local marker = PlotStatus.GetSpawn(plot)
	if not marker then return false, "PLOT SPAWN UNAVAILABLE" end
	return Teleports.Near(player, marker.CFrame)
end

function Teleports.ToDestination(player, id, adminService)
	if id == "AdminRoom" then
		if not body(player) then return false, "CHARACTER NOT READY" end
		return adminService:EnterAdminRoom(player), "ADMIN ROOM UNAVAILABLE"
	elseif id == "PlayerPlots" then
		local plot = PlotStatus.GetPlayerPlot(player) or PlotLocator.getPlots()[1]
		local marker = plot and PlotStatus.GetSpawn(plot)
		if not marker then return false, "PLAYER PLOTS UNAVAILABLE" end
		return Teleports.Near(player, marker.CFrame)
	elseif id == "Town" then
		local town = PlotLocator.getTown()
		-- Live Studio keeps TownPlaza directly under Workspace. Older places
		-- keep it inside AnimalKingdomTown; support both inspected layouts.
		local plaza = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TownPlaza") or (town and town:FindFirstChild("TownPlaza", true))
		if not plaza or not plaza:IsA("BasePart") then return false, "TOWN PLAZA UNAVAILABLE" end
		return Teleports.Near(player, plaza.CFrame)
	end
	local destinationName
	for name, biomeId in pairs(BiomeDestinations) do if id == biomeId then destinationName = name; break end end
	if not destinationName then return false, "UNKNOWN DESTINATION" end
	local floor = Landing.FindFloor(id)
	if not floor then return false, "BIOME FLOOR UNAVAILABLE" end
	local markers = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BiomeTeleportPoints")
	local marker = markers and markers:FindFirstChild(destinationName)
	if marker and marker:IsA("BasePart") and Landing.Move(player.Character, marker, floor) then return true end
	-- Reuse the camera's known target as a hint, never its aerial camera position.
	local cameras = Workspace:FindFirstChild("AK_AdminCameraPoints")
	local camera = cameras and cameras:FindFirstChild(id)
	local hint = camera and camera:GetAttribute("TargetCenter")
	local point = typeof(hint) == "Vector3" and Landing.Check(hint, floor, player.Character) or nil
	point = point or Landing.FindSafePoint(floor, floor.Position)
	if point and Landing.Move(player.Character, {Position=point}, floor) then return true end
	return false, "NO SAFE BIOME LANDING"
end

return Teleports

local RoomPanels = {}
local panelNames = {"PlayerControl", "ServerStatus", "Announcements", "Teleports", "EventQueue", "ActivityLog"}

local function preserveReadableCameraTitles(room)
	-- The live place also has CameraPanelTitles, which recreates legacy labels
	-- after room construction. Replace only its text; retain camera parts,
	-- SurfaceGui faces, ClickDetectors, and all camera behavior.
	local function replace(object)
		if not object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:GetAttribute("ReadableAdminTitle") then return end
		local surface = object.Parent
		local wall = room:FindFirstChild("CameraWallPanels")
		if not surface or not surface:IsA("SurfaceGui") or not wall or not object:IsDescendantOf(wall) then return end
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = object.Name
		label:SetAttribute("ReadableAdminTitle", true)
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = object.Text
		label.TextColor3 = object.TextColor3
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextScaled = false
		label.TextSize = 24
		label.TextWrapped = false
		label.RichText = false
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		label.ZIndex = object.ZIndex
		local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
		padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
		padding.Parent = label
		surface.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
		surface.PixelsPerStud = 12
		object:Destroy()
		label.Parent = surface
	end
	local connection = room.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		-- Wait until the creator finishes assigning the label's text and style.
		task.defer(function() if object.Parent then replace(object) end end)
	end)
	room.Destroying:Once(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
	for _, object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do replace(object) end
end

function RoomPanels.Attach(room)
	if room:FindFirstChild("AdminCommandCenter") then return room.AdminCommandCenter end
	local floor = room:FindFirstChild("Floor")
	local back = room:FindFirstChild("BackWall")
	if not floor or not floor:IsA("BasePart") or not back or not back:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, "Existing WeatherAdminRoom Floor/BackWall references are unavailable"
	end
	-- The inspected room has unused rear wall space. Derive placement from its
	-- actual floor/wall; leave the camera wall, event controls, and arrival pad alone.
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "AdminCommandCenter"
	local width = math.min(42, (floor.Size.X - 32) / 3)
	local height = math.min(14, (back.Size.Y - 10) / 2)
	if width < 24 or height < 10 then folder:Destroy(); return nil, "Admin room has insufficient rear wall space" end
	local spacing = (floor.Size.X - 14) / 3
	for index, name in ipairs(panelNames) do
		local column = (index - 1) % 3 - 1
		local row = math.floor((index - 1) / 3)
		-- The existing StatusPanel occupies the rear center at height 10.5.
		-- Stack the center pair above it; side panels retain their full height.
		local panelHeight = column == 0 and 10 or height
		local elevation = column == 0 and (row == 0 and 30 or 18) or (row == 0 and 28 or 11)
		local position = floor.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(column * spacing, floor.Size.Y/2 + elevation, floor.Size.Z/2 - 2.2))
		local panel = Instance.new("Part")
		panel.Name = name
		panel.Size = Vector3.new(width, panelHeight, 0.35)
		panel.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position - floor.CFrame.ZVector)
		panel.Color = Color3.fromRGB(8,24,48)
		panel.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		panel.Anchored = true
		panel.CanCollide = false
		panel.CanTouch = false
		panel.Parent = folder
	end
	folder.Parent = room
	preserveReadableCameraTitles(room)
	return folder
end

return RoomPanels
